addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- claude-code-guide: Use this agent when the user asks questions ("Can Claude...", "Does Claude...", "How do I...") about: (1) Claude Code (the CLI tool) - features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings, IDE integrations, keyboard shortcuts; (2) Claude Agent SDK - building custom agents; (3) Claude API (formerly Anthropic API) - Messages API for directly passing messages to Claude, Tool Runner (`client.beta.messages.tool_runner`) for running an agentic loop over your own tools, manual tool-use loops, Managed Agents for server-hosted agents with a managed sandbox, prompt caching, and general Anthropic SDK usage; (4) Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) - what it is, setting it up for a Slack workspace, `/install-slack-app`. **IMPORTANT:** Before spawning a new agent, check if there is already a running or recently completed claude-code-guide agent that you can continue via SendMessage. (Tools: Glob, Grep, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)

- Explore: Fast read-only search agent for locating code. Use it to find files by pattern (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), grep for symbols or keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer "where is X defined / which files reference Y." Do NOT use it for code review, design-doc auditing, cross-file consistency checks, or open-ended analysis — it reads excerpts rather than whole files and will miss content past its read window. When calling, specify search breadth: "quick" for a single targeted lookup, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" to search across multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

- vercel:ai-architect: Specializes in architecting AI-powered applications on Vercel — choosing between AI SDK patterns, configuring providers, building agents, setting up durable workflows, and integrating MCP servers. Use when designing AI features, building chatbots, or creating agentic applications. (Tools: All tools)

- vercel:deployment-expert: Specializes in Vercel deployment strategies, CI/CD pipelines, preview URLs, production promotions, rollbacks, environment variables, and domain configuration. Use when troubleshooting deployments, setting up CI/CD, or optimizing the deploy pipeline. (Tools: All tools)

- vercel:performance-optimizer: Specializes in optimizing Vercel application performance — Core Web Vitals, rendering strategies, caching, image optimization, font loading, edge computing, and bundle size. Use when investigating slow pages, improving Lighthouse scores, or optimizing loading performance. (Tools: All tools)

## claude-in-chrome
**IMPORTANT: If the Chrome browser tools are deferred (must be loaded via ToolSearch before use), load them with ToolSearch before calling them, and batch every tool you expect to need into ONE ToolSearch call (the select query accepts a comma-separated list). Do NOT load tools one at a time; each separate ToolSearch call wastes a full round-trip.**

Start a browser task whose tools are not yet loaded with a single call loading the core set:

ToolSearch with query "select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp"

Add task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting. Only issue a second ToolSearch if the task later needs a tool you did not anticipate.

## claude.ai Supabase
Here are guidelines for using Supabase tools effectively:

- Before making schema changes, use `list_tables` to understand the existing structure
- When debugging issues, start with `get_logs` and `get_advisors` before making changes
- Use `get_project_url` and `get_publishable_api_key` when helping users configure client-side integrations

If you have access to a local development environment with a filesystem and shell:
- Install the Supabase agent skill for critical development and security guidance: `npx skills add supabase/agent-skills` (https://supabase.com/docs/guides/getting-started/ai-skills.md)
- Use the Supabase CLI (`supabase`) for local development workflows such as starting a local stack, managing migrations, and running edge functions locally (https://supabase.com/docs/guides/local-development.md)
- Prefer local development and testing before applying changes to a remote project

If you are running in a web-only or remote environment without filesystem or shell access:
- Rely on the MCP tools directly for all Supabase interactions
- Use `apply_migration` carefully, as changes go directly to the remote project

## plugin:context7:context7
Use this server to fetch current documentation whenever the user asks about a library, framework, SDK, API, CLI tool, or cloud service — even well-known ones like React, Next.js, Prisma, Express, Tailwind, Django, or Spring Boot. This includes API syntax, configuration, version migration, library-specific debugging, setup instructions, and CLI tool usage. Use even when you think you know the answer — your training data may not reflect recent changes. Prefer this over web search for library docs.

Do not use for: refactoring, writing scripts from scratch, debugging business logic, code review, or general programming concepts.

content.text: The background code-review finished. Here are the findings, ranked by severity:

findings.short_summary: AutoFit runs on stale formulas under manual calc mode
findings.summary: Application.Calculate is deferred to after all department sheets (and their FinalizeSheet/AutoFit calls) have run, but Calculation is set to xlCalculationManual the whole time, so AutoFit measures uncalculated formula results.
findings.failure_scenario: With Calculation=xlCalculationManual set earlier in the sub, every COUNTIFS/SUMIFS formula FinalizeSheet writes into the summary block (Days Worked, Hours Worked, per-week columns) stays uncalculated until the single Application.Calculate at line 53, which runs after ALL department sheets' FinalizeSheet/AutoFit calls have already executed. AutoFit sizes columns based on stale/blank/zero results instead of real totals, producing truncated or ###-displayed summary columns until the user manually widens them or forces recalculation.

findings.short_summary: Carry-forward only copies 1 of 4 loaded fields
findings.summary: ApplyCarryForward only writes cf(2) (Staff Follow Up) to the output; cf(0)/cf(1)/cf(3) (Inflight FC Status, Date Updated, Remarks), which LoadPreviousMFC loads, are never written back.
findings.failure_scenario: A still-open backlog case from the previous MFC report had Inflight FC Status, Date Updated, and Remarks entered by staff. On the new report those three columns are now blank for the same encounter (only Staff Follow Up carries forward), forcing staff to re-discover and re-enter status/remarks for every backlog case each cycle instead of reviewing just what changed.

findings.short_summary: Summary table (and 2 manual-entry fields) deleted, no replacement
findings.summary: SummaryTable.bas (WriteSummaryTable) was deleted and is no longer called from Backlog.bas, removing the in-sheet executive summary block along with its two manual-entry cells ("To Follow Up on CCF", "EL Admissions") with nothing replacing them.
findings.failure_scenario: Previously staff read Total Cases/Backlog/Today's Cases/To Follow Up on CCF/EL Admissions from a table at the bottom of the output sheet and typed the two manual figures into dedicated cells each report cycle. Now MainMacro's completion MsgBox only reports the three computed values; "To Follow Up on CCF" and "EL Admissions" have no cell to enter into or read from anywhere in the deliverable workbook, silently dropping that data from the report.

findings.short_summary: Config upgrade rename looks for wrong old header name
findings.summary: CreateConfigSheet's upgrade path searches for a header literally named "NCID Wards" to rename it to "Included NCID Wards", but the actual pre-existing header (per the old GetExcludedNCIDWards) was "Excluded NCID Wards" — FindColByHeader's exact match never fires.
findings.failure_scenario: A team that already ran the previous CreateConfigSheet has a Config column titled "Excluded NCID Wards" holding their customized ward list. Running the upgraded version finds oldNCIDCol = 0, so the rename never happens; the old column is orphaned (nothing reads it anymore), a new "All NCID Wards" column is inserted with hardcoded defaults, and GetIncludedNCIDWards()/GetAllNCIDWards() silently fall back to hardcoded lists instead of the team's real customization — with only a generic "Config sheet upgraded" message and no warning that customization was lost.

findings.short_summary: Valid 24:00 shift time incorrectly rejected
findings.summary: IsValidShiftTime requires d < 1, rejecting a Start/End Time of exactly 24:00 (Excel day-fraction 1.0), which is a legitimate way to express a midnight shift boundary.
findings.failure_scenario: A department's tblSchedule row has an End Time of 24:00 (serial value 1.0) for a shift ending at midnight. LoadConfig now raises "tblSchedule row for DEPT/WEEKDAY has a Start Time or End Time that is not a valid time of day" and aborts report generation, even though 24:00 is a valid, commonly-used way to represent midnight in Excel.

findings.short_summary: Application.Calculate recalcs all open workbooks, not just output
findings.summary: Application.Calculate recalculates every open workbook in the Excel instance rather than scoping to the newly built output workbook.
findings.failure_scenario: If the user has other large workbooks open while running the macro, Application.Calculate forces a full recalculation of all of them too, adding avoidable delay; outWb.Calculate (or scoping via Application.CalculateFullRebuild on just the relevant sheets) would recalculate only what the macro just wrote.

findings.short_summary: Header-resolution boilerplate duplicated across two files
findings.summary: The resCol/encCol header-resolution boilerplate (FindColByHeader with two fallback layers) is duplicated verbatim in TagAndGroupNCID (Backlog.bas) and ClearMarkedRows (Dropdowns.bas) instead of factored into a shared helper.
findings.failure_scenario: If the fallback column-index defaults or hdr() index mapping ever need to change (e.g. Output Headers layout changes), both copies must be updated in lockstep by hand across two files; missing one silently reintroduces a stale hardcoded column number in only one of the two subs.

The review flagged 7 issues across the Attendance VBA and MFC VBA Inflight repos (not this FC Completion repo). Top ones worth fixing first:

1. **Attendance VBA/MainMacro.bas:53** — `Application.Calculate` fires after all sheets are already built/AutoFit'd while calc mode is manual, so summary columns get sized against stale/blank formula results.
2. **MFC Backlog.bas:179** — carry-forward logic loads 4 fields from the previous report but only writes 1 back, silently dropping Inflight FC Status/Date Updated/Remarks for backlog cases.
3. **MFC SummaryTable.bas** — deleted outright with no replacement, losing the executive summary block and two manual-entry fields from the output.
4. **MFC Helpers.bas:129** — config upgrade path checks for a header name (`"NCID Wards"`) that never matches the real old one (`"Excluded NCID Wards"`), so it silently orphans teams' customized ward lists instead of migrating them.

5	' DeduplicateEncounters.bas
6	'
7	' Implements Section 2 (steps 3-8) of
8	' docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md for File A
9	' (FC Summary Report), after FilterFileA's mode/cancellation cleaning:

12	'   AddPriorityColumn     -- writes a "PRIORITISE" column using the table above
13	'   MarkDuplicateEncounters -- Step 5 (visual aid): highlight duplicate
14	'                              Encounter Numbers in red. Call this BEFORE
15	'                              ResolveDuplicateEncounters if you want a
16	'                              before-snapshot, since resolution deletes the
17	'                              losing rows.
18	'   ResolveDuplicateEncounters -- Steps 6-8: for each Encounter Number with
19	'                              more than one row, automatically picks the row
20	'                              to keep and deletes the rest. Also counts
21	'                              encounters whose only row is Voided/Deleted
22	'                              (priority 99) for the "please double-check"
23	'                              report -- these single rows are NOT deleted.
24	'
25	' Q2-Q4 from the process flow doc were confirmed 2026-06-18, then revised
26	' 2026-07-29 against "Guide to monthly processing of report 3.docx" (the
27	' authoritative source, which the process flow doc had silently diverged
28	' from): priority 99 now means Voided/Deleted only (Decision 2), and the
29	' Inflight exception (Q3) was narrowed (Decision 4) -- it only overrides the
30	' plain "lowest priority wins" rule when a non-Inflight ED/EDFC-created row is
31	' in the group AND the resulting winner has priority <= 2. Driven by the
32	' Config "Staff Name -> Team" roster (Helpers.LoadStaffRoster) -- with an
33	' empty/unfilled roster everyone is "Others", so the exception never fires and
34	' the algorithm reduces to "lowest priority wins, tie-break by largest FC ID".
35	' ============================================================
36	
37	' ---- Step 3: FC Status priority order -----------------------------------------
38	'
39	' Lower number = better outcome = row to keep when an encounter has duplicates.
40	'
41	' Decision 2 (2026-07-29 conflict resolution): priority 99 is reserved for
42	' Voided/Deleted ONLY, matched via case-insensitive substring ("VOID" / "DELET")
43	' so wording variants (e.g. "Voided", "Deleted by Admin") are still caught.
44	' Everything else that isn't one of the six explicit statuses below -- Draft
45	' variants, blanks, typos, brand-new eFC statuses -- is priority 98 ("not
46	' completed" but NOT excluded from the denominator the way 99 is). Callers
47	' that need to surface unrecognised status text (for the Summary sheet warning
48	' block) should compare the input status against this function's Case list
49	' themselves; this function only returns the priority number.
50	Public Function GetFCStatusPriority(fcStatus As String) As Long
51	    Dim s As String
52	    s = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(fcStatus))
53	
54	    If InStr(s, "VOID") > 0 Or InStr(s, "DELET") > 0 Then
55	        GetFCStatusPriority = 99
56	        Exit Function
57	    End If
58	
59	    Select Case s
60	        Case "COMPLETED"
61	            GetFCStatusPriority = 1
62	        Case "ACKNOWLEDGEMENT BY OTHER MEANS"
63	            GetFCStatusPriority = 2
64	        Case "ATTEMPTED - VIRTUAL FC COMPLETED, PENDING SIGNATURE"
65	            GetFCStatusPriority = 3
66	        Case "ATTEMPTED - PATIENT/NOK DECLINES TO SIGN"
67	            GetFCStatusPriority = 4
68	        Case "ATTEMPTED - PATIENT IS UNABLE TO SIGN"
69	            GetFCStatusPriority = 5
70	        Case "ATTEMPTED - UNABLE TO COMPLETE"
71	            GetFCStatusPriority = 6
72	        Case Else
73	            GetFCStatusPriority = 98   ' Draft variants, blanks, typos, new statuses -- NOT excluded from denominator
74	    End Select
75	End Function
76	
77	' Adds a "PRIORITISE" column as the last column, populated via
78	' GetFCStatusPriority for every data row. Lets staff see at a glance why the
79	' tool kept or dropped a given row.
80	Public Sub AddPriorityColumn(ws As Worksheet)
81

97

101	
102	    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
103	
104	    Dim statusData As Variant
105	    statusData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, fcStatusCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, fcStatusCol)).Value
106	
107	    Dim priData() As Variant
108	    ReDim priData(1 To lastRow - 1, 1 To 1)
109

127	' Applies red fill + white font to every row whose Encounter Number appears
128	' more than once. Purely cosmetic -- does not change row order or count.
129	Public Sub MarkDuplicateEncounters(ws As Worksheet)
130	
131	    Dim encCol As Long
132	    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
133	    If encCol = 0 Then Exit Sub
134	
135	    Dim lastRow As Long
136	    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
137	    If lastRow < 3 Then Exit Sub   ' need at least 2 data rows for a duplicate
138	
139	    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
140	
141	    Dim encData As Variant
142	    encData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, encCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, encCol)).Value
143	
144	    Dim counts As Object
145	    Set counts = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
146	    counts.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
147	
148	    Dim i As Long
149	    Dim key As String
150	    For i = 1 To UBound(encData, 1)
151	        key = Trim(CStr(encData(i, 1)))
152	        If counts.Exists(key) Then
153	            counts(key) = counts(key) + 1
154	        Else
155	            counts(key) = 1
156	        End If
157	    Next i
158	
159	    Dim dupRange As Range
160	    For i = 1 To UBound(encData, 1)
161	        key = Trim(CStr(encData(i, 1)))
162	        If counts(key) > 1 Then
163	            If dupRange Is Nothing Then
164	                Set dupRange = ws.Rows(i + 1)
165	            Else
166	                Set dupRange = Union(dupRange, ws.Rows(i + 1))
167	            End If
168	        End If
169	    Next i
170	
171	    If Not dupRange Is Nothing Then
172	        dupRange.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
173	        dupRange.Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
174	    End If

178	End Sub

180	' ---- Steps 6-8: automatic duplicate resolution -----------------------------------------
181	'
182	' For each Encounter Number with more than one row:
183	'   1. Compute the "plain" winner across ALL candidates: lowest
184	'      GetFCStatusPriority wins, ties broken by the larger FC ID (assumed to
185	'      be the more recently created one).
186	'   2. The narrow Inflight exception (Decision 4, 2026-07-29 conflict
187	'      resolution) only overrides the plain winner when BOTH hold:
188	'      a) at least one non-Inflight candidate in the group was created by an
189	'         ED/EDFC staff member (per the Config roster), AND
190	'      b) the winner that would result from setting Inflight rows aside has
191	'         priority <= 2 (i.e. Completed / Acknowledgement by other means).
192	'      When both hold, Inflight-created rows are set aside and the winner is
193	'      recomputed from the remaining (non-Inflight) candidates. Otherwise the
194	'      plain winner from step 1 stands -- this replaces the old, broader rule
195	'      that set Inflight rows aside whenever ANY non-Inflight row survived.
196	'   3. The winner is kept; every other row for that encounter is deleted.
197	'
198	' For each Encounter Number with exactly one row, that row is always kept --
199	' even if its priority is 99 (Voided/Deleted) -- but it is counted in
200	' voidedOnlyCount so MainMacro/BuildOutput can report it separately. As of
201	' the 2026-07-30 "Revert B" change, these encounters are NOT excluded from
202	' the denominator (that was Q4's original answer, but it disagreed with
203	' actual practice) -- BuildOutput.bas now counts every Voided/Deleted-only
204	' encounter (whether from a solo group here, or the winner of a group where
205	' every candidate was Voided/Deleted) IN the denominator and IN "not
206	' completed", via its own per-row priority-99 check post-dedup.
207	'
208	' roster: Dictionary from Helpers.LoadStaffRoster (Staff Name -> Team).
209	'
210	' Returns False (and shows a MsgBox) if a required column is missing.
211	' On success, voidedOnlyCount, duplicateGroupsResolved, rowsRemoved,
212	' inflightExceptionApplied and inflightExceptionBlocked are filled in for the
213	' final summary dialog and the Methodology sheet.
214	Public Function ResolveDuplicateEncounters(ws As Worksheet, roster As Object, _
215	        ByRef voidedOnlyCount As Long, ByRef duplicateGroupsResolved As Long, _
216	        ByRef rowsRemoved As Long, ByRef inflightExceptionApplied As Long, _
217	        ByRef inflightExceptionBlocked As Long) As Boolean

224	    inflightExceptionApplied = 0
225	    inflightExceptionBlocked = 0

229	    fcIdCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC ID")
230	    fcStatusCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Status")

243	    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Function
244	    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

256

262	        groups(encVal).Add i

299	            Dim hasNonInflightED As Boolean

303	                createdBy = ""
304	                If createdByCol > 0 Then createdBy = CStr(allData(candidates(idx), createdByCol))
305	                Dim createdByTeam As String
306	                createdByTeam = GetStaffTeam(roster, createdBy)
307	                If createdByTeam = TEAM_INFLIGHT Then
308	                    isInflight(idx) = True
309	                    inflightCount = inflightCount + 1
310	                ElseIf createdByTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then
311	                    hasNonInflightED = True
312	                End If
313	            Next idx
314	
315	            ' Step 1: plain winner across ALL candidates (lowest priority,
316	            ' tie-break larger FC ID). This is the fallback whenever the
317	            ' narrow Inflight exception doesn't apply.
318	            Dim plainWinnerIdx As Long, plainWinnerPriority As Long
319	            Dim plainWinnerFCID As Variant
320	            Dim rowI As Long, pr As Long

323	                rowI = candidates(idx)

336	                        plainWinnerFCID = allData(rowI, fcIdCol)
337	                    End If
338	                End If
339	            Next idx
340

342	            ' Guard (a): there is an Inflight row AND a non-Inflight candidate
343	            ' remains AND that non-Inflight side includes an ED/EDFC creator.

392	        End If

415	        Next i
416	
417	        ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(keepCount, lastCol)).Value = outData
418	        ws.Rows((keepCount + 1) & ":" & lastRow).Delete
419	    End If
420	
421	    Application.StatusBar = "Duplicate resolution complete: " & duplicateGroupsResolved & _
422	        " encounter(s) had duplicates resolved (" & rowsRemoved & " row(s) removed); " & _
423	        voidedOnlyCount & " voided/deleted-only encounter(s) flagged for review."
424	
425	    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
426	    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
427	    Exit Function
428	
429	ErrHandler:
430	    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
431	    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
432	    MsgBox "Unexpected error during duplicate resolution:" & vbNewLine & _
433	           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
434	    ResolveDuplicateEncounters = False
435	
436	End Function
437	
438	' Compares two FC ID values for the tie-break in ResolveDuplicateEncounters.
439	' Returns >0 if a is "later" (larger) than b, <0 if earlier, 0 if equal.
440	' Numeric FC IDs are compared numerically; anything else falls back to a
441	' text comparison (assumes same-length/zero-padded IDs sort correctly as
442	' strings -- confirm FC ID format once a real export is available).
443	Private Function CompareFCID(a As Variant, b As Variant) As Long
444	    Dim sa As String, sb As String
445	    sa = Trim(CStr(a))
446	    sb = Trim(CStr(b))
447	
448	    If IsNumeric(sa) And IsNumeric(sb) Then
449	        If CDbl(sa) > CDbl(sb) Then
450	            CompareFCID = 1
451	        ElseIf CDbl(sa) < CDbl(sb) Then
452	            CompareFCID = -1
453	        Else
454	            CompareFCID = 0
455	        End If
456	    Else
457	        CompareFCID = StrComp(sa, sb, vbTextCompare)
458	    End If

Attribute VB_Name = "DeduplicateEncounters"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' DeduplicateEncounters.bas
'
' Implements Section 2 (steps 3-8) of
' docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md for File A
' (FC Summary Report), after FilterFileA's mode/cancellation cleaning:
'
'   GetFCStatusPriority   -- Step 3: priority order table (1 = best)
'   AddPriorityColumn     -- writes a "PRIORITISE" column using the table above
'   MarkDuplicateEncounters -- Step 5 (visual aid): highlight duplicate
'                              Encounter Numbers in red. Call this BEFORE
'                              ResolveDuplicateEncounters if you want a
'                              before-snapshot, since resolution deletes the
'                              losing rows.
'   ResolveDuplicateEncounters -- Steps 6-8: for each Encounter Number with
'                              more than one row, automatically picks the row
'                              to keep and deletes the rest. Also counts
'                              encounters whose only row is Voided/Deleted
'                              (priority 99) for the "please double-check"
'                              report -- these single rows are NOT deleted.
'
' Q2-Q4 from the process flow doc were confirmed 2026-06-18, then revised
' 2026-07-29 against "Guide to monthly processing of report 3.docx" (the
' authoritative source, which the process flow doc had silently diverged
' from): priority 99 now means Voided/Deleted only (Decision 2), and the
' Inflight exception (Q3) was narrowed (Decision 4) -- it only overrides the
' plain "lowest priority wins" rule when a non-Inflight ED/EDFC-created row is
' in the group AND the resulting winner has priority <= 2. Driven by the
' Config "Staff Name -> Team" roster (Helpers.LoadStaffRoster) -- with an
' empty/unfilled roster everyone is "Others", so the exception never fires and
' the algorithm reduces to "lowest priority wins, tie-break by largest FC ID".
' ============================================================

' ---- Step 3: FC Status priority order -----------------------------------------
'
' Lower number = better outcome = row to keep when an encounter has duplicates.
'
' Decision 2 (2026-07-29 conflict resolution): priority 99 is reserved for
' Voided/Deleted ONLY, matched via case-insensitive substring ("VOID" / "DELET")
' so wording variants (e.g. "Voided", "Deleted by Admin") are still caught.
' Everything else that isn't one of the six explicit statuses below -- Draft
' variants, blanks, typos, brand-new eFC statuses -- is priority 98 ("not
' completed" but NOT excluded from the denominator the way 99 is). Callers
' that need to surface unrecognised status text (for the Summary sheet warning
' block) should compare the input status against this function's Case list
' themselves; this function only returns the priority number.
Public Function GetFCStatusPriority(fcStatus As String) As Long
    Dim s As String
    s = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(fcStatus))

    If InStr(s, "VOID") > 0 Or InStr(s, "DELET") > 0 Then
        GetFCStatusPriority = 99
        Exit Function
    End If

    Select Case s
        Case "COMPLETED"
            GetFCStatusPriority = 1
        Case "ACKNOWLEDGEMENT BY OTHER MEANS"
            GetFCStatusPriority = 2
        Case "ATTEMPTED - VIRTUAL FC COMPLETED, PENDING SIGNATURE"
            GetFCStatusPriority = 3
        Case "ATTEMPTED - PATIENT/NOK DECLINES TO SIGN"
            GetFCStatusPriority = 4
        Case "ATTEMPTED - PATIENT IS UNABLE TO SIGN"
            GetFCStatusPriority = 5
        Case "ATTEMPTED - UNABLE TO COMPLETE"
            GetFCStatusPriority = 6
        Case Else
            GetFCStatusPriority = 98   ' Draft variants, blanks, typos, new statuses -- NOT excluded from denominator
    End Select
End Function

' Adds a "PRIORITISE" column as the last column, populated via
' GetFCStatusPriority for every data row. Lets staff see at a glance why the
' tool kept or dropped a given row.
Public Sub AddPriorityColumn(ws As Worksheet)

    Dim fcStatusCol As Long
    fcStatusCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Status")
    If fcStatusCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    If encCol > 0 Then
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    Else
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, fcStatusCol).End(xlUp).Row
    End If
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Dim priCol As Long
    priCol = lastCol + 1
    ws.Cells(1, priCol).Value = "PRIORITISE"

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    Dim statusData As Variant
    statusData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, fcStatusCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, fcStatusCol)).Value

    Dim priData() As Variant
    ReDim priData(1 To lastRow - 1, 1 To 1)

    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To lastRow - 1
        If lastRow = 2 Then
            priData(i, 1) = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(statusData))
        Else
            priData(i, 1) = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(statusData(i, 1)))
        End If
    Next i

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, priCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, priCol)).Value = priData

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

End Sub

' ---- Step 5: highlight duplicate Encounter Numbers (visual aid) -----------------------------------------
'
' Applies red fill + white font to every row whose Encounter Number appears
' more than once. Purely cosmetic -- does not change row order or count.
Public Sub MarkDuplicateEncounters(ws As Worksheet)

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    If encCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 3 Then Exit Sub   ' need at least 2 data rows for a duplicate

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    Dim encData As Variant
    encData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, encCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, encCol)).Value

    Dim counts As Object
    Set counts = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    counts.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim i As Long
    Dim key As String
    For i = 1 To UBound(encData, 1)
        key = Trim(CStr(encData(i, 1)))
        If counts.Exists(key) Then
            counts(key) = counts(key) + 1
        Else
            counts(key) = 1
        End If
    Next i

    Dim dupRange As Range
    For i = 1 To UBound(encData, 1)
        key = Trim(CStr(encData(i, 1)))
        If counts(key) > 1 Then
            If dupRange Is Nothing Then
                Set dupRange = ws.Rows(i + 1)
            Else
                Set dupRange = Union(dupRange, ws.Rows(i + 1))
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    If Not dupRange Is Nothing Then
        dupRange.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        dupRange.Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End If

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

End Sub

' ---- Steps 6-8: automatic duplicate resolution -----------------------------------------
'
' For each Encounter Number with more than one row:
'   1. Compute the "plain" winner across ALL candidates: lowest
'      GetFCStatusPriority wins, ties broken by the larger FC ID (assumed to
'      be the more recently created one).
'   2. The narrow Inflight exception (Decision 4, 2026-07-29 conflict
'      resolution) only overrides the plain winner when BOTH hold:
'      a) at least one non-Inflight candidate in the group was created by an
'         ED/EDFC staff member (per the Config roster), AND
'      b) the winner that would result from setting Inflight rows aside has
'         priority <= 2 (i.e. Completed / Acknowledgement by other means).
'      When both hold, Inflight-created rows are set aside and the winner is
'      recomputed from the remaining (non-Inflight) candidates. Otherwise the
'      plain winner from step 1 stands -- this replaces the old, broader rule
'      that set Inflight rows aside whenever ANY non-Inflight row survived.
'   3. The winner is kept; every other row for that encounter is deleted.
'
' For each Encounter Number with exactly one row, that row is always kept --
' even if its priority is 99 (Voided/Deleted) -- but it is counted in
' voidedOnlyCount so MainMacro/BuildOutput can report it separately. As of
' the 2026-07-30 "Revert B" change, these encounters are NOT excluded from
' the denominator (that was Q4's original answer, but it disagreed with
' actual practice) -- BuildOutput.bas now counts every Voided/Deleted-only
' encounter (whether from a solo group here, or the winner of a group where
' every candidate was Voided/Deleted) IN the denominator and IN "not
' completed", via its own per-row priority-99 check post-dedup.
'
' roster: Dictionary from Helpers.LoadStaffRoster (Staff Name -> Team).
'
' Returns False (and shows a MsgBox) if a required column is missing.
' On success, voidedOnlyCount, duplicateGroupsResolved, rowsRemoved,
' inflightExceptionApplied and inflightExceptionBlocked are filled in for the
' final summary dialog and the Methodology sheet.
Public Function ResolveDuplicateEncounters(ws As Worksheet, roster As Object, _
        ByRef voidedOnlyCount As Long, ByRef duplicateGroupsResolved As Long, _
        ByRef rowsRemoved As Long, ByRef inflightExceptionApplied As Long, _
        ByRef inflightExceptionBlocked As Long) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    voidedOnlyCount = 0
    duplicateGroupsResolved = 0
    rowsRemoved = 0
    inflightExceptionApplied = 0
    inflightExceptionBlocked = 0

    Dim encCol As Long, fcIdCol As Long, fcStatusCol As Long, createdByCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    fcIdCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC ID")
    fcStatusCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Status")
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Created By")

    If encCol = 0 Or fcIdCol = 0 Or fcStatusCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File A is missing one of 'Encounter Number', 'FC ID', or 'FC Status'." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the FC Summary Report export.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        ResolveDuplicateEncounters = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    ResolveDuplicateEncounters = True

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Function
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

    Dim allData As Variant
    allData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    ' --- Group data row indices (2..lastRow) by Encounter Number ---
    Dim groups As Object
    Set groups = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    groups.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim i As Long
    Dim encVal As String
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        encVal = Trim(CStr(allData(i, encCol)))
        If Not groups.Exists(encVal) Then groups.Add encVal, New Collection
        groups(encVal).Add i
    Next i

    ' --- Decide which rows to keep ---
    Dim keepFlag() As Boolean
    ReDim keepFlag(1 To lastRow)
    keepFlag(1) = True   ' header row

    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In groups.Keys
        Dim grp As Collection
        Set grp = groups(k)

        If grp.Count = 1 Then
            Dim soloIdx As Long
            soloIdx = grp(1)
            keepFlag(soloIdx) = True
            If GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(allData(soloIdx, fcStatusCol))) = 99 Then
                voidedOnlyCount = voidedOnlyCount + 1
            End If
        Else
            Dim n As Long
            n = grp.Count

            Dim candidates() As Long
            ReDim candidates(1 To n)
            Dim idx As Long
            For idx = 1 To n
                candidates(idx) = grp(idx)
            Next idx

            ' Classify each candidate's creator team, and note whether any
            ' non-Inflight candidate was created by ED/EDFC (Decision 4 guard a).
            Dim isInflight() As Boolean
            ReDim isInflight(1 To n)
            Dim inflightCount As Long
            inflightCount = 0
            Dim hasNonInflightED As Boolean
            hasNonInflightED = False
            For idx = 1 To n
                Dim createdBy As String
                createdBy = ""
                If createdByCol > 0 Then createdBy = CStr(allData(candidates(idx), createdByCol))
                Dim createdByTeam As String
                createdByTeam = GetStaffTeam(roster, createdBy)
                If createdByTeam = TEAM_INFLIGHT Then
                    isInflight(idx) = True
                    inflightCount = inflightCount + 1
                ElseIf createdByTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then
                    hasNonInflightED = True
                End If
            Next idx

            ' Step 1: plain winner across ALL candidates (lowest priority,
            ' tie-break larger FC ID). This is the fallback whenever the
            ' narrow Inflight exception doesn't apply.
            Dim plainWinnerIdx As Long, plainWinnerPriority As Long
            Dim plainWinnerFCID As Variant
            Dim rowI As Long, pr As Long
            plainWinnerIdx = 0
            For idx = 1 To n
                rowI = candidates(idx)
                pr = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(allData(rowI, fcStatusCol)))
                If plainWinnerIdx = 0 Then
                    plainWinnerIdx = idx
                    plainWinnerPriority = pr
                    plainWinnerFCID = allData(rowI, fcIdCol)
                ElseIf pr < plainWinnerPriority Then
                    plainWinnerIdx = idx
                    plainWinnerPriority = pr
                    plainWinnerFCID = allData(rowI, fcIdCol)
                ElseIf pr = plainWinnerPriority Then
                    If CompareFCID(allData(rowI, fcIdCol), plainWinnerFCID) > 0 Then
                        plainWinnerIdx = idx
                        plainWinnerFCID = allData(rowI, fcIdCol)
                    End If
                End If
            Next idx

            ' Step 2: consider the narrow Inflight exception (Decision 4).
            ' Guard (a): there is an Inflight row AND a non-Inflight candidate
            ' remains AND that non-Inflight side includes an ED/EDFC creator.
            Dim exceptionGuardA As Boolean
            exceptionGuardA = (inflightCount > 0 And inflightCount < n And hasNonInflightED)

            Dim winnerIdx As Long
            winnerIdx = plainWinnerIdx

            If exceptionGuardA Then
                ' Winner among non-Inflight candidates only.
                Dim excWinnerIdx As Long, excWinnerPriority As Long
                Dim excWinnerFCID As Variant
                excWinnerIdx = 0
                For idx = 1 To n
                    If Not isInflight(idx) Then
                        rowI = candidates(idx)
                        pr = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(allData(rowI, fcStatusCol)))
                        If excWinnerIdx = 0 Then
                            excWinnerIdx = idx
                            excWinnerPriority = pr
                            excWinnerFCID = allData(rowI, fcIdCol)
                        ElseIf pr < excWinnerPriority Then
                            excWinnerIdx = idx
                            excWinnerPriority = pr
                            excWinnerFCID = allData(rowI, fcIdCol)
                        ElseIf pr = excWinnerPriority Then
                            If CompareFCID(allData(rowI, fcIdCol), excWinnerFCID) > 0 Then
                                excWinnerIdx = idx
                                excWinnerFCID = allData(rowI, fcIdCol)
                            End If
                        End If
                    End If
                Next idx

                ' Guard (b): the resulting winner must have priority <= 2.
                If excWinnerPriority <= 2 Then
                    winnerIdx = excWinnerIdx
                    inflightExceptionApplied = inflightExceptionApplied + 1
                Else
                    winnerIdx = plainWinnerIdx
                    inflightExceptionBlocked = inflightExceptionBlocked + 1
                End If
            End If

            For idx = 1 To n
                keepFlag(candidates(idx)) = (idx = winnerIdx)
            Next idx

            duplicateGroupsResolved = duplicateGroupsResolved + 1
            rowsRemoved = rowsRemoved + (n - 1)
        End If
    Next k

    ' --- Build the kept-rows array and write it back ---
    Dim keepCount As Long
    keepCount = 0
    For i = 1 To lastRow
        If keepFlag(i) Then keepCount = keepCount + 1
    Next i

    If keepCount < lastRow Then
        Dim outData() As Variant
        ReDim outData(1 To keepCount, 1 To lastCol)

        Dim outRow As Long, j As Long
        outRow = 0
        For i = 1 To lastRow
            If keepFlag(i) Then
                outRow = outRow + 1
                For j = 1 To lastCol
                    outData(outRow, j) = allData(i, j)
                Next j
            End If
        Next i

        ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(keepCount, lastCol)).Value = outData
        ws.Rows((keepCount + 1) & ":" & lastRow).Delete
    End If

    Application.StatusBar = "Duplicate resolution complete: " & duplicateGroupsResolved & _
        " encounter(s) had duplicates resolved (" & rowsRemoved & " row(s) removed); " & _
        voidedOnlyCount & " voided/deleted-only encounter(s) flagged for review."

    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "Unexpected error during duplicate resolution:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    ResolveDuplicateEncounters = False

End Function

' Compares two FC ID values for the tie-break in ResolveDuplicateEncounters.
' Returns >0 if a is "later" (larger) than b, <0 if earlier, 0 if equal.
' Numeric FC IDs are compared numerically; anything else falls back to a
' text comparison (assumes same-length/zero-padded IDs sort correctly as
' strings -- confirm FC ID format once a real export is available).
Private Function CompareFCID(a As Variant, b As Variant) As Long
    Dim sa As String, sb As String
    sa = Trim(CStr(a))
    sb = Trim(CStr(b))

    If IsNumeric(sa) And IsNumeric(sb) Then
        If CDbl(sa) > CDbl(sb) Then
            CompareFCID = 1
        ElseIf CDbl(sa) < CDbl(sb) Then
            CompareFCID = -1
        Else
            CompareFCID = 0
        End If
    Else
        CompareFCID = StrComp(sa, sb, vbTextCompare)
    End If
End Function

1	Attribute VB_Name = "Helpers"
2	Option Explicit
3	
4	' ============================================================
5	' Helpers.bas
6	'
7	' Shared utilities for the FC Completion Report macro:
8	'   - Column lookup by header (tolerant of wrapped/whitespace headers)
9	'   - Text normalisation (en/em dash variants -- see NormalizeDashesAndSpaces)
10	'   - Input file validation (FilePickerForm)
11	'   - Staff roster (Config sheet): Staff Name -> Team lookup
12	'   - NCID EL Point of Care list (Config sheet): informational NCID Ward
13	'     breakdown only (2026-07-30 -- no longer gates the EL sheet, see
14	'     BuildOutput.bas Revert A)
15	'   - Row/encounter-count snapshots for the Summary sheet reconciliation
16	'     waterfall (CountDataRows, GetDistinctEncounterSet, CountKeysNotIn)
17	'   - Roster coverage guard (ComputeRosterCoverage) -- run before
18	'     BuildOutputWorkbook so an empty/unmatched roster is caught, not
19	'     silently reported as 100% "Others"
20	'   - SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare -- Alt+F8 bootstrap that suggests a
21	'     Staff Name -> Team roster from an FC Summary Report export
22	'   - ExportStaffRoster / ImportStaffRoster -- CSV round trip so the roster
23	'     survives the report's monthly hand-off between team leads
24	'
25	' Team names used throughout the macro (DeduplicateEncounters, BuildOutput):
26	'   ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO, ICH PSO, Admin/Managers, Others
27	' "Others" is the default for any staff name not listed in the Config sheet,
28	' so the macro runs correctly even before the roster is filled in.
29	' ============================================================
30	
31	Public Const TEAM_ED_EDFC As String = "ED/EDFC"
32	Public Const TEAM_INFLIGHT As String = "Inflight"
33	Public Const TEAM_NCID_AO As String = "NCID AO"
34	Public Const TEAM_ICH_PSO As String = "ICH PSO"
35	Public Const TEAM_ADMIN As String = "Admin/Managers"
36	Public Const TEAM_OTHERS As String = "Others"
37	
38	' ---- Column lookup -----------------------------------------
39	
40	' Searches row 1 of ws for a column whose header matches headerName.
41	' Matching is case-insensitive and whitespace-tolerant: line breaks
42	' (Alt+Enter / wrapped headers), non-breaking spaces, and runs of spaces
43	' are all normalised to a single space before comparison.
44	' Returns the 1-based column index, or 0 if not found.
45	Public Function FindColByHeader(ws As Worksheet, headerName As String) As Long
46	    Dim lastCol As Long
47	    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
48	
49	    Dim target As String
50	    target = NormHeader(headerName)
51	
52	    Dim c As Long
53	    For c = 1 To lastCol
54	        If NormHeader(CStr(ws.Cells(1, c).Value)) = target Then
55	            FindColByHeader = c
56	            Exit Function
57	        End If
58	    Next c
59	
60	    FindColByHeader = 0
61	End Function
62	
63	' Normalises a header string for tolerant comparison:
64	'   - converts line breaks (Chr 10 / 13) and non-breaking spaces (Chr 160) to spaces
65	'   - collapses any run of spaces to a single space
66	'   - trims ends and upper-cases
67	Public Function NormHeader(s As String) As String
68	    Dim t As String
69	    t = CStr(s)
70	    t = Replace(t, Chr(10), " ")
71	    t = Replace(t, Chr(13), " ")
72	    t = Replace(t, Chr(160), " ")
73	    t = Replace(t, vbTab, " ")
74	    Do While InStr(t, "  ") > 0
75	        t = Replace(t, "  ", " ")
76	    Loop
77	    NormHeader = UCase(Trim(t))
78	End Function
79	
80	' Encounter Number column is labelled differently across the two eFC exports:
81	'   - FC Summary Report (File A)         -> "Encounter Number"
82	'   - Inflight Missed FC Report (File B) -> "Encounter No"
83	' Try both spellings so the rest of the macro can use one column lookup.
84	Public Function FindEncounterCol(ws As Worksheet) As Long
85	    Dim col As Long
86	    col = FindColByHeader(ws, "Encounter Number")
87	    If col = 0 Then col = FindColByHeader(ws, "Encounter No")
88	    FindEncounterCol = col
89	End Function
90	
91	' ---- Text normalisation (dash variants) -----------------------------------------
92	
93	' The "Guide to monthly processing of report 3.docx" writes FC Mode as
94	' "Financial Counselling - AH" using an EN DASH (both in prose and in its
95	' sample data table), not a plain hyphen. If a real eFC export also uses an
96	' en dash (or an em dash), a straight ASCII-hyphen comparison would delete
97	' every row and the user would see "No Financial Counselling rows found".
98	' Normalises en dash (Chr(150) -- Windows-1252 -- and ChrW(8211) -- Unicode)
99	' and em dash (ChrW(8212)) to a plain "-", then collapses runs of spaces and
100	' trims. Run BOTH sides of every FC Mode / FC Status comparison through this.
101	Public Function NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(s As String) As String
102	    Dim t As String
103	    t = CStr(s)
104	    t = Replace(t, Chr(150), "-")     ' Windows-1252 en dash
105	    t = Replace(t, ChrW(8211), "-")   ' Unicode en dash
106	    t = Replace(t, ChrW(8212), "-")   ' Unicode em dash
107	    Do While InStr(t, "  ") > 0
108	        t = Replace(t, "  ", " ")
109	    Loop
110	    NormalizeDashesAndSpaces = Trim(t)
111	End Function
112	
113	' ---- File validation (used by FilePickerForm) -----------------------------------------
114	
115	' Validates that wb's first sheet has the critical columns for fileType.
116	'   "FC_SUMMARY"      -- File A, FC Summary Report
117	'   "INFLIGHT_MISSED" -- File B, Inflight Missed FC Report (Missed FC ticked)
118	Public Function ValidateFileHeaders(wb As Workbook, fileType As String) As Boolean
119	    Dim ws As Worksheet
120	    Set ws = wb.Sheets(1)
121	
122	    Dim isValid As Boolean
123	    isValid = False
124	
125	    Select Case UCase(fileType)
126	        Case "FC_SUMMARY"
127	            ' Critical columns per CLAUDE.md: FC ID, Encounter Number, FC Status, FC Mode
128	            If FindColByHeader(ws, "FC ID") > 0 And _
129	               FindEncounterCol(ws) > 0 And _
130	               FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Status") > 0 And _
131	               FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Mode") > 0 Then
132	                isValid = True
133	            End If
134	
135	        Case "INFLIGHT_MISSED"
136	            ' Critical columns per CLAUDE.md: Encounter No, Missed FC, Admission Status
137	            If FindEncounterCol(ws) > 0 And _

542	' ---- Roster coverage guard (PART 4.1, 2026-07-30) --------------------------
543	
544	' Measures the fraction of File A encounters (post-cleaning, pre-dedup or
545	' post-dedup -- either works, since dedup keeps exactly one row per encounter)
546	' whose resolved CCF closer (Latest CCF Creation User, falling back to FC
547	' Created By per Q7) maps to a NAMED team rather than "Others". Call this
548	' after File A cleaning/dedup and before BuildOutputWorkbook so MainMacro can
549	' warn the user (or offer to abort) before an empty/unmatched roster silently
550	' produces a Summary claiming 100% of CCFs were closed by "Others".
551	'
552	' unmatchedNames is filled with distinct unmatched resolved-closer names ->
553	' row count, descending-sortable via SortDictKeysDescending.
554	Public Function ComputeRosterCoverage(fileAws As Worksheet, roster As Object, _
555	        ByRef unmatchedNames As Object) As Double
556	
557	    Set unmatchedNames = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
558	    unmatchedNames.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
559	
560	    Dim encCol As Long, createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long
561	    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
562	    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Created By")
563	    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
564	
565	    If encCol = 0 Then
566	        ComputeRosterCoverage = 0
567	        Exit Function
568	    End If
569	
570	    Dim lastRow As Long
571	    lastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
572	    If lastRow < 2 Then
573	        ComputeRosterCoverage = 0
574	        Exit Function
575	    End If
576	
577	    Dim cbData As Variant, lcData As Variant
578	    If createdByCol > 0 Then cbData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, createdByCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, createdByCol)).Value
579	    If latestCCFCol > 0 Then lcData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, latestCCFCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, latestCCFCol)).Value
580	
581	    Dim total As Long, matched As Long
582	    Dim i As Long, nm As String, cbNm As String, lcNm As String
583	
584	    For i = 1 To (lastRow - 1)
585	        If createdByCol > 0 Then
586	            If lastRow = 2 Then cbNm = Trim(CStr(cbData)) Else cbNm = Trim(CStr(cbData(i, 1)))
587	        Else
588	            cbNm = ""
589	        End If
590	        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then
591	            If lastRow = 2 Then lcNm = Trim(CStr(lcData)) Else lcNm = Trim(CStr(lcData(i, 1)))
592	        Else
593	            lcNm = ""
594	        End If
595	
596	        If lcNm <> "" Then
597	            nm = lcNm
598	        ElseIf cbNm <> "" Then
599	            nm = cbNm
600	        Else
601	            nm = ""
602	        End If
603	
604	        total = total + 1
605	        If nm <> "" Then
606	            If GetStaffTeam(roster, nm) <> TEAM_OTHERS Then
607	                matched = matched + 1
608	            Else
609	                Dim normNm As String
610	                normNm = NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(nm)
611	                If unmatchedNames.Exists(normNm) Then
612	                    unmatchedNames(normNm) = unmatchedNames(normNm) + 1
613	                Else
614	                    unmatchedNames(normNm) = 1
615	                End If
616	            End If
617	        End If
618	    Next i
619	
620	    If total = 0 Then
621	        ComputeRosterCoverage = 0
622	    Else
623	        ComputeRosterCoverage = matched / total
624	    End If
625	End Function

627	' Returns the keys of a Dictionary(String -> Long) sorted by value descending,
628	' as a String array. Used everywhere an unmatched-name or suggestion list
629	' needs to show the biggest-impact entries first. VBA has no built-in sort,
630	' hence the manual insertion sort -- fine at the scale of a few hundred names.
631	Public Function SortDictKeysDescending(d As Object) As Variant
632	    Dim n As Long
633	    n = d.Count
634	    If n = 0 Then
635	        SortDictKeysDescending = Array()
636	        Exit Function
637	    End If
638	
639	    Dim keys() As String, counts() As Long
640	    ReDim keys(1 To n)
641	    ReDim counts(1 To n)
642	
643	    Dim k As Variant, idx As Long
644	    idx = 0
645	    For Each k In d.Keys
646	        idx = idx + 1
647	        keys(idx) = CStr(k)
648	        counts(idx) = CLng(d(k))
649	    Next k
650	
651	    Dim a As Long, b As Long, tmpS As String, tmpL As Long
652	    For a = 2 To n
653	        tmpS = keys(a): tmpL = counts(a)
654	        b = a - 1
655	        ' VBA's And is NOT short-circuit: "b >= 1 And counts(b) < tmpL" still
656	        ' evaluates counts(0) once b reaches 0, which is out of bounds for a
657	        ' 1-based array -- run-time error 9. Test the bound separately.
658	        Do While b >= 1
659	            If counts(b) >= tmpL Then Exit Do
660	            keys(b + 1) = keys(b)
661	            counts(b + 1) = counts(b)
662	            b = b - 1
663	        Loop
664	        keys(b + 1) = tmpS
665	        counts(b + 1) = tmpL
666	    Next a
667	
668	    SortDictKeysDescending = keys
669	End Function

1112	Private Function ParseCSVLine(ln As String) As String()

1114	    Dim cap As Long
1115	    cap = 10
1116	    ReDim result(0 To cap - 1)
1117	    Dim count As Long
1118	    count = 0
1119	
1120	    Dim i As Long, ch As String, field As String, inQuotes As Boolean
1121	    inQuotes = False
1122	    field = ""
1123	    i = 1
1124	    Do While i <= Len(ln)
1125	        ch = Mid(ln, i, 1)
1126	        If inQuotes Then
1127	            If ch = """" Then
1128	                If i < Len(ln) And Mid(ln, i + 1, 1) = """" Then
1129	                    field = field & """"
1130	                    i = i + 1
1131	                Else
1132	                    inQuotes = False
1133	                End If
1134	            Else
1135	                field = field & ch
1136	            End If
1137	        Else
1138	            If ch = """" Then
1139	                inQuotes = True
1140	            ElseIf ch = "," Then
1141	                If count >= cap Then
1142	                    cap = cap * 2
1143	                    ReDim Preserve result(0 To cap - 1)
1144	                End If
1145	                result(count) = field
1146	                count = count + 1
1147	                field = ""
1148	            Else
1149	                field = field & ch
1150	            End If
1151	        End If
1152	        i = i + 1
1153	    Loop
1154	
1155	    If count >= cap Then
1156	        cap = cap + 1
1157	        ReDim Preserve result(0 To cap - 1)
1158	    End If
1159	    result(count) = field
1160	    count = count + 1
1161	
1162	    ReDim Preserve result(0 To count - 1)
1163	    ParseCSVLine = result
1164	End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "Helpers"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' Helpers.bas
'
' Shared utilities for the FC Completion Report macro:
'   - Column lookup by header (tolerant of wrapped/whitespace headers)
'   - Text normalisation (en/em dash variants -- see NormalizeDashesAndSpaces)
'   - Input file validation (FilePickerForm)
'   - Staff roster (Config sheet): Staff Name -> Team lookup
'   - NCID EL Point of Care list (Config sheet): informational NCID Ward
'     breakdown only (2026-07-30 -- no longer gates the EL sheet, see
'     BuildOutput.bas Revert A)
'   - Row/encounter-count snapshots for the Summary sheet reconciliation
'     waterfall (CountDataRows, GetDistinctEncounterSet, CountKeysNotIn)
'   - Roster coverage guard (ComputeRosterCoverage) -- run before
'     BuildOutputWorkbook so an empty/unmatched roster is caught, not
'     silently reported as 100% "Others"
'   - SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare -- Alt+F8 bootstrap that suggests a
'     Staff Name -> Team roster from an FC Summary Report export
'   - ExportStaffRoster / ImportStaffRoster -- CSV round trip so the roster
'     survives the report's monthly hand-off between team leads
'
' Team names used throughout the macro (DeduplicateEncounters, BuildOutput):
'   ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO, ICH PSO, Admin/Managers, Others
' "Others" is the default for any staff name not listed in the Config sheet,
' so the macro runs correctly even before the roster is filled in.
' ============================================================

Public Const TEAM_ED_EDFC As String = "ED/EDFC"
Public Const TEAM_INFLIGHT As String = "Inflight"
Public Const TEAM_NCID_AO As String = "NCID AO"
Public Const TEAM_ICH_PSO As String = "ICH PSO"
Public Const TEAM_ADMIN As String = "Admin/Managers"
Public Const TEAM_OTHERS As String = "Others"

' ---- Column lookup -----------------------------------------

' Searches row 1 of ws for a column whose header matches headerName.
' Matching is case-insensitive and whitespace-tolerant: line breaks
' (Alt+Enter / wrapped headers), non-breaking spaces, and runs of spaces
' are all normalised to a single space before comparison.
' Returns the 1-based column index, or 0 if not found.
Public Function FindColByHeader(ws As Worksheet, headerName As String) As Long
    Dim lastCol As Long
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Dim target As String
    target = NormHeader(headerName)

    Dim c As Long
    For c = 1 To lastCol
        If NormHeader(CStr(ws.Cells(1, c).Value)) = target Then
            FindColByHeader = c
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next c

    FindColByHeader = 0
End Function

' Normalises a header string for tolerant comparison:
'   - converts line breaks (Chr 10 / 13) and non-breaking spaces (Chr 160) to spaces
'   - collapses any run of spaces to a single space
'   - trims ends and upper-cases
Public Function NormHeader(s As String) As String
    Dim t As String
    t = CStr(s)
    t = Replace(t, Chr(10), " ")
    t = Replace(t, Chr(13), " ")
    t = Replace(t, Chr(160), " ")
    t = Replace(t, vbTab, " ")
    Do While InStr(t, "  ") > 0
        t = Replace(t, "  ", " ")
    Loop
    NormHeader = UCase(Trim(t))
End Function

' Encounter Number column is labelled differently across the two eFC exports:
'   - FC Summary Report (File A)         -> "Encounter Number"
'   - Inflight Missed FC Report (File B) -> "Encounter No"
' Try both spellings so the rest of the macro can use one column lookup.
Public Function FindEncounterCol(ws As Worksheet) As Long
    Dim col As Long
    col = FindColByHeader(ws, "Encounter Number")
    If col = 0 Then col = FindColByHeader(ws, "Encounter No")
    FindEncounterCol = col
End Function

' ---- Text normalisation (dash variants) -----------------------------------------

' The "Guide to monthly processing of report 3.docx" writes FC Mode as
' "Financial Counselling - AH" using an EN DASH (both in prose and in its
' sample data table), not a plain hyphen. If a real eFC export also uses an
' en dash (or an em dash), a straight ASCII-hyphen comparison would delete
' every row and the user would see "No Financial Counselling rows found".
' Normalises en dash (Chr(150) -- Windows-1252 -- and ChrW(8211) -- Unicode)
' and em dash (ChrW(8212)) to a plain "-", then collapses runs of spaces and
' trims. Run BOTH sides of every FC Mode / FC Status comparison through this.
Public Function NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(s As String) As String
    Dim t As String
    t = CStr(s)
    t = Replace(t, Chr(150), "-")     ' Windows-1252 en dash
    t = Replace(t, ChrW(8211), "-")   ' Unicode en dash
    t = Replace(t, ChrW(8212), "-")   ' Unicode em dash
    Do While InStr(t, "  ") > 0
        t = Replace(t, "  ", " ")
    Loop
    NormalizeDashesAndSpaces = Trim(t)
End Function

' ---- File validation (used by FilePickerForm) -----------------------------------------

' Validates that wb's first sheet has the critical columns for fileType.
'   "FC_SUMMARY"      -- File A, FC Summary Report
'   "INFLIGHT_MISSED" -- File B, Inflight Missed FC Report (Missed FC ticked)
Public Function ValidateFileHeaders(wb As Workbook, fileType As String) As Boolean
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = wb.Sheets(1)

    Dim isValid As Boolean
    isValid = False

    Select Case UCase(fileType)
        Case "FC_SUMMARY"
            ' Critical columns per CLAUDE.md: FC ID, Encounter Number, FC Status, FC Mode
            If FindColByHeader(ws, "FC ID") > 0 And _
               FindEncounterCol(ws) > 0 And _
               FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Status") > 0 And _
               FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Mode") > 0 Then
                isValid = True
            End If

        Case "INFLIGHT_MISSED"
            ' Critical columns per CLAUDE.md: Encounter No, Missed FC, Admission Status
            If FindEncounterCol(ws) > 0 And _
               FindColByHeader(ws, "Missed FC") > 0 And _
               FindColByHeader(ws, "Admission Status") > 0 Then
                isValid = True
            End If
    End Select

    ValidateFileHeaders = isValid
End Function

' Returns True if File B's "Missed FC" column exists but is entirely blank --
' i.e. the export was taken without ticking the "Missed FC" indicator.
' FilePickerForm uses this to warn the user to re-export with the indicator
' ticked, or use the manual eFC dashboard workaround export (CLAUDE.md).
Public Function IsMissedFCColumnBlank(wb As Workbook) As Boolean
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = wb.Sheets(1)

    Dim missedCol As Long
    missedCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Missed FC")
    If missedCol = 0 Then
        IsMissedFCColumnBlank = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        IsMissedFCColumnBlank = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        IsMissedFCColumnBlank = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim data As Variant
    data = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, missedCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, missedCol)).Value

    Dim i As Long
    If lastRow = 2 Then
        ' Single-cell range comes back as a scalar, not a 2-D array
        IsMissedFCColumnBlank = (Trim(CStr(data)) = "")
        Exit Function
    End If

    For i = 1 To UBound(data, 1)
        If Trim(CStr(data(i, 1))) <> "" Then
            IsMissedFCColumnBlank = False
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next i

    IsMissedFCColumnBlank = True
End Function

' answer). The list is still used for the informational "NCID Ward" breakdown
' on the EL sheet/summary and to warn if a Point of Care value containing
' "NCID" isn't in this list (PART 3 of the 2026-07-30 change set).
Public Function LoadNCIDPointOfCareList() As Object

    Set list = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    list.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")

        Set LoadNCIDPointOfCareList = list
