' Loads the Staff Name -> Team roster from the Config sheet into a Dictionary
' (keys are staff names, case-insensitive). Returns an empty Dictionary if the
' Config sheet doesn't exist yet or is missing its headers -- GetStaffTeam then
' defaults everyone to "Others", so the macro still runs correctly before the
' roster is filled in.
Public Function LoadStaffRoster() As Object
    Dim roster As Object
    Set roster = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    roster.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        Set LoadStaffRoster = roster
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim nameCol As Long, teamCol As Long
    nameCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Staff Name")
    teamCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Team")
    If nameCol = 0 Or teamCol = 0 Then
        Set LoadStaffRoster = roster
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, nameCol).End(xlUp).Row

    Dim i As Long
    Dim nm As String, tm As String
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        ' Run the roster key through NormalizeDashesAndSpaces (4.2, 2026-07-30):
        ' real eFC names carry stray double spaces / trailing whitespace, and a
        ' raw Trim() alone was letting those silently fall through to "Others".
        nm = NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(CStr(ws.Cells(i, nameCol).Value))
        tm = Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(i, teamCol).Value))
        If nm <> "" And tm <> "" Then roster(nm) = tm
    Next i

    Set LoadStaffRoster = roster
End Function

' Returns the team for a given staff name, looked up from the roster Dictionary
' returned by LoadStaffRoster. Defaults to "Others" if the name is blank, not
' found in the roster, or the roster is empty.
'
' Both the roster keys (LoadStaffRoster) and the lookup name here are run
' through NormalizeDashesAndSpaces before comparing (4.2, 2026-07-30) -- the
' roster.CompareMode = vbTextCompare already handles case, but not doubled/
' trailing whitespace, which real eFC display names do contain.
Public Function GetStaffTeam(roster As Object, staffName As String) As String
    Dim nm As String
    nm = NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(staffName)

    If nm = "" Then
        GetStaffTeam = TEAM_OTHERS
    ElseIf roster.Exists(nm) Then
        GetStaffTeam = CStr(roster(nm))
    Else
        GetStaffTeam = TEAM_OTHERS
    End If
End Function

' ---- Reconciliation waterfall helpers (PART 3.3, 2026-07-30) --------------

' Number of data rows currently on ws (0 if the Encounter column is missing
' or the sheet has no data rows). Used by MainMacro to snapshot row counts
' before/after each File A cleaning step for the Summary sheet waterfall.
Public Function CountDataRows(ws As Worksheet) As Long
    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        CountDataRows = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        CountDataRows = 0
    Else
        CountDataRows = lastRow - 1
    End If
End Function

' Distinct Encounter Number values currently on ws, as a Dictionary (keys are
' encounter numbers, vbTextCompare; values unused). Used by MainMacro to
' measure how many distinct encounters vanish entirely across a filtering
' step (e.g. the Shopper-only encounters lost to the FC Mode filter, PART 2.4).
Public Function GetDistinctEncounterSet(ws As Worksheet) As Object
    Dim result As Object
    Set result = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    result.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        Set GetDistinctEncounterSet = result
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        Set GetDistinctEncounterSet = result
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim data As Variant
    data = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, encCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, encCol)).Value

    Dim i As Long, key As String
    If lastRow = 2 Then
        key = Trim(CStr(data))
        If key <> "" Then result(key) = True
    Else
        For i = 1 To UBound(data, 1)
            key = Trim(CStr(data(i, 1)))
            If key <> "" Then result(key) = True
        Next i
    End If

    Set GetDistinctEncounterSet = result
End Function

' Count of keys in setA that are NOT present in setB -- used to measure
' encounters lost entirely across a filtering step (PART 2.4 / PART 3.3).
' NOTE: GetDistinctEncounterSet skips blank Encounter Number values, so a row
' with a blank encounter number is invisible to this diff -- see
' CountBlankEncounterRows for why that matters for the FC Mode filter.
Public Function CountKeysNotIn(setA As Object, setB As Object) As Long
    Dim n As Long
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In setA.Keys
        If Not setB.Exists(CStr(k)) Then n = n + 1
    Next k
    CountKeysNotIn = n
End Function

' Number of data rows on ws whose Encounter Number is blank. Real eFC exports
' have at least one FC Mode (e.g. Shopper) that is submitted with NO
' Encounter Number at all -- such rows are invisible to
' GetDistinctEncounterSet/CountKeysNotIn (which key on Encounter Number), so
' MainMacro uses this alongside that diff to detect "the FC Mode filter
' dropped a blank-encounter row" without overcounting: since a blank
' encounter number can't be disambiguated into separate real encounters, all
' such rows lost to a filter are counted as at most ONE "encounter" (see
' MainMacro's encountersLostToModeFilter calculation, PART 2.4/3.3).
Public Function CountBlankEncounterRows(ws As Worksheet) As Long
    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        CountBlankEncounterRows = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        CountBlankEncounterRows = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim data As Variant
    data = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, encCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, encCol)).Value

    Dim i As Long, n As Long
    If lastRow = 2 Then
        If Trim(CStr(data)) = "" Then n = 1
    Else
        For i = 1 To UBound(data, 1)
            If Trim(CStr(data(i, 1))) = "" Then n = n + 1
        Next i
    End If

    CountBlankEncounterRows = n
End Function

' ---- Roster coverage guard (PART 4.1, 2026-07-30) --------------------------

' Measures the fraction of File A encounters (post-cleaning, pre-dedup or
' post-dedup -- either works, since dedup keeps exactly one row per encounter)
' whose resolved CCF closer (Latest CCF Creation User, falling back to FC
' Created By per Q7) maps to a NAMED team rather than "Others". Call this
' after File A cleaning/dedup and before BuildOutputWorkbook so MainMacro can
' warn the user (or offer to abort) before an empty/unmatched roster silently
' produces a Summary claiming 100% of CCFs were closed by "Others".
'
' unmatchedNames is filled with distinct unmatched resolved-closer names ->
' row count, descending-sortable via SortDictKeysDescending.
Public Function ComputeRosterCoverage(fileAws As Worksheet, roster As Object, _
        ByRef unmatchedNames As Object) As Double

    Set unmatchedNames = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    unmatchedNames.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim encCol As Long, createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Created By")
    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Latest CCF Creation User")

    If encCol = 0 Then
        ComputeRosterCoverage = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        ComputeRosterCoverage = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim cbData As Variant, lcData As Variant
    If createdByCol > 0 Then cbData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, createdByCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, createdByCol)).Value
    If latestCCFCol > 0 Then lcData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, latestCCFCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, latestCCFCol)).Value

    Dim total As Long, matched As Long
    Dim i As Long, nm As String, cbNm As String, lcNm As String

    For i = 1 To (lastRow - 1)
        If createdByCol > 0 Then
            If lastRow = 2 Then cbNm = Trim(CStr(cbData)) Else cbNm = Trim(CStr(cbData(i, 1)))
        Else
            cbNm = ""
        End If
        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then
            If lastRow = 2 Then lcNm = Trim(CStr(lcData)) Else lcNm = Trim(CStr(lcData(i, 1)))
        Else
            lcNm = ""
        End If

        If lcNm <> "" Then
            nm = lcNm
        ElseIf cbNm <> "" Then
            nm = cbNm
        Else
            nm = ""
        End If

        total = total + 1
        If nm <> "" Then
            If GetStaffTeam(roster, nm) <> TEAM_OTHERS Then
                matched = matched + 1
            Else
                Dim normNm As String
                normNm = NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(nm)
                If unmatchedNames.Exists(normNm) Then
                    unmatchedNames(normNm) = unmatchedNames(normNm) + 1
                Else
                    unmatchedNames(normNm) = 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    If total = 0 Then
        ComputeRosterCoverage = 0
    Else
        ComputeRosterCoverage = matched / total
    End If
End Function

' Returns the keys of a Dictionary(String -> Long) sorted by value descending,
' as a String array. Used everywhere an unmatched-name or suggestion list
' needs to show the biggest-impact entries first. VBA has no built-in sort,
' hence the manual insertion sort -- fine at the scale of a few hundred names.
Public Function SortDictKeysDescending(d As Object) As Variant
    Dim n As Long
    n = d.Count
    If n = 0 Then
        SortDictKeysDescending = Array()
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim keys() As String, counts() As Long
    ReDim keys(1 To n)
    ReDim counts(1 To n)

    Dim k As Variant, idx As Long
    idx = 0
    For Each k In d.Keys
        idx = idx + 1
        keys(idx) = CStr(k)
        counts(idx) = CLng(d(k))
    Next k

    Dim a As Long, b As Long, tmpS As String, tmpL As Long
    For a = 2 To n
        tmpS = keys(a): tmpL = counts(a)
        b = a - 1
        ' VBA's And is NOT short-circuit: "b >= 1 And counts(b) < tmpL" still
        ' evaluates counts(0) once b reaches 0, which is out of bounds for a
        ' 1-based array -- run-time error 9. Test the bound separately.
        Do While b >= 1
            If counts(b) >= tmpL Then Exit Do
            keys(b + 1) = keys(b)
            counts(b + 1) = counts(b)
            b = b - 1
        Loop
        keys(b + 1) = tmpS
        counts(b + 1) = tmpL
    Next a

    SortDictKeysDescending = keys
End Function

' ---- SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare bootstrap (PART 4.3, 2026-07-30) ----------

' One-off bootstrap so a blank Config roster is never faced cold. Run via
' Alt+F8. Prompts for an FC Summary Report export, tallies Point Of Care per
' staff name (across BOTH "FC Created By" and "Latest CCF Creation User"),
' and writes suggestions to the Config sheet:
'   - A reference table in columns F:K (Staff Name | Rows | Dominant Point Of
'     Care | % Dominant | Suggested Team | Confidence), sorted by Rows
'     descending.
'   - Fills the main roster's Team column (B) ONLY where it is currently
'     blank -- an existing non-blank Team is NEVER overwritten. Staff names
'     not yet in the roster at all are appended as new rows with the
'     suggested team.
' Suggestions are a STARTING POINT only -- the team leads' own staff lists
' are authoritative.
Public Sub SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare()
    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFilePicker)
    fd.title = "Select FC Summary Report export for team suggestions"
    fd.Filters.Clear
    fd.Filters.Add "Excel Files", "*.xlsx; *.xlsm; *.xls"
    If fd.Show <> -1 Then Exit Sub

    Dim wb As Workbook
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(fd.SelectedItems(1))
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = wb.Sheets(1)

    Dim createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long, pocCol As Long, encCol As Long
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Created By")
    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
    pocCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Point of Care")
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)

    If pocCol = 0 Or (createdByCol = 0 And latestCCFCol = 0) Then
        MsgBox "Cannot suggest teams: this export is missing 'Point of Care' and/or both " & _
            "'FC Created By' / 'Latest CCF Creation User' columns.", vbExclamation, "Missing Columns"
        wb.Close SaveChanges:=False
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    If encCol > 0 Then
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    Else
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, pocCol).End(xlUp).Row
    End If

    ' nameData(staffName) = Dictionary of pocValue -> count
    Dim nameData As Object
    Set nameData = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    nameData.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim i As Long
    Dim cbNm As String, lcNm As String, pocVal As String

    If lastRow >= 2 Then
        Dim cbData As Variant, lcData As Variant, pocData As Variant
        If createdByCol > 0 Then cbData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, createdByCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, createdByCol)).Value
        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then lcData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, latestCCFCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, latestCCFCol)).Value
        pocData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, pocCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, pocCol)).Value

        For i = 1 To (lastRow - 1)
            If lastRow = 2 Then
                pocVal = Trim(CStr(pocData))
            Else
                pocVal = Trim(CStr(pocData(i, 1)))
            End If

            If createdByCol > 0 Then
                If lastRow = 2 Then cbNm = Trim(CStr(cbData)) Else cbNm = Trim(CStr(cbData(i, 1)))
                If cbNm <> "" Then TallyStaffPOC nameData, cbNm, pocVal
            End If
            If latestCCFCol > 0 Then
                If lastRow = 2 Then lcNm = Trim(CStr(lcData)) Else lcNm = Trim(CStr(lcData(i, 1)))
                If lcNm <> "" Then TallyStaffPOC nameData, lcNm, pocVal
            End If
        Next i
    End If

    wb.Close SaveChanges:=False

    If nameData.Count = 0 Then
        MsgBox "No staff names found in the export.", vbExclamation, "No Data"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim cfg As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set cfg = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If cfg Is Nothing Then
        CreateConfigSheet
        Set cfg = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    End If

    ' Existing roster rows (normalised name -> row number), so suggestions
    ' merge into the roster instead of duplicating rows.
    Dim existingRow As Object
    Set existingRow = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    existingRow.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    Dim lastRosterRow As Long
    lastRosterRow = cfg.Cells(cfg.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
    Dim r As Long, en As String
    For r = 2 To lastRosterRow
        en = NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(CStr(cfg.Cells(r, 1).Value))
        If en <> "" Then existingRow(en) = r
    Next r

    ' Suggestion reference table headers (columns F:K)
    cfg.Cells(1, 6).Value = "Staff Name"
    cfg.Cells(1, 7).Value = "Rows"
    cfg.Cells(1, 8).Value = "Dominant Point Of Care"
    cfg.Cells(1, 9).Value = "% Dominant"
    cfg.Cells(1, 10).Value = "Suggested Team"
    cfg.Cells(1, 11).Value = "Confidence"
    With cfg.Range(cfg.Cells(1, 6), cfg.Cells(1, 11))
        .Font.Bold = True
        .Interior.Color = RGB(31, 73, 125)
        .Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End With
    On Error Resume Next
    cfg.Cells(1, 6).Comment.Delete
    On Error GoTo 0
    cfg.Cells(1, 6).AddComment "Suggestions from SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare (Alt+F8) -- a " & _
        "STARTING POINT only. Your team leads' own staff lists are authoritative -- always " & _
        "confirm before relying on these, especially anything flagged 'LOW -- please confirm'."

    Dim namesSorted As Variant
    namesSorted = SortDictKeysDescending(RowCountsFromNameData(nameData))

    Dim suggestedCounts As Object
    Set suggestedCounts = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Dim lowCount As Long

    Dim outRow As Long
    outRow = 2
    Dim idx As Long
    For idx = LBound(namesSorted) To UBound(namesSorted)
        Dim staffName As String
        staffName = CStr(namesSorted(idx))
        Dim pocDict As Object
        Set pocDict = nameData(staffName)

        Dim domPoc As String, domCount As Long, totalCount As Long
        DominantPOC pocDict, domPoc, domCount, totalCount

        Dim pctDom As Double
        If totalCount > 0 Then pctDom = domCount / totalCount Else pctDom = 0

        Dim suggestedTeam As String
        suggestedTeam = SuggestTeamFromPOC(domPoc)

        Dim confidence As String
        If pctDom < 0.5 Then
            confidence = "LOW -- please confirm"
            lowCount = lowCount + 1
        Else
            confidence = "OK"
        End If

        cfg.Cells(outRow, 6).Value = staffName
        cfg.Cells(outRow, 7).Value = totalCount
        cfg.Cells(outRow, 8).Value = domPoc
        cfg.Cells(outRow, 9).Value = pctDom
        cfg.Cells(outRow, 9).NumberFormat = "0%"
        cfg.Cells(outRow, 10).Value = suggestedTeam
        cfg.Cells(outRow, 11).Value = confidence

        If suggestedCounts.Exists(suggestedTeam) Then
            suggestedCounts(suggestedTeam) = suggestedCounts(suggestedTeam) + 1
        Else
            suggestedCounts(suggestedTeam) = 1
        End If

        ' Fill roster Team column only if blank -- never overwrite an existing team.
        Dim normStaffName As String
        normStaffName = NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(staffName)
        If existingRow.Exists(normStaffName) Then
            Dim rr As Long
            rr = existingRow(normStaffName)
            If Trim(CStr(cfg.Cells(rr, 2).Value)) = "" Then
                cfg.Cells(rr, 2).Value = suggestedTeam
            End If
        Else
            lastRosterRow = lastRosterRow + 1
            cfg.Cells(lastRosterRow, 1).Value = staffName
            cfg.Cells(lastRosterRow, 2).Value = suggestedTeam
            existingRow(normStaffName) = lastRosterRow
        End If

        outRow = outRow + 1
    Next idx

    cfg.Columns("A:K").AutoFit

    Dim summaryMsg As String
    summaryMsg = (UBound(namesSorted) - LBound(namesSorted) + 1) & " staff name(s) analysed." & vbNewLine
    Dim tk As Variant
    For Each tk In suggestedCounts.Keys
        summaryMsg = summaryMsg & "  " & CStr(tk) & ": " & suggestedCounts(tk) & vbNewLine
    Next tk
    summaryMsg = summaryMsg & vbNewLine & lowCount & " name(s) flagged LOW -- please confirm."

    MsgBox summaryMsg, vbInformation, "Team Suggestions Complete"
End Sub

' Builds a Dictionary(staffName -> total row count) from the nameData
' structure (staffName -> Dictionary(pocValue -> count)), for SortDictKeysDescending.
Private Function RowCountsFromNameData(nameData As Object) As Object
    Dim result As Object
    Set result = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    result.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In nameData.Keys
        result(CStr(k)) = SumDict(nameData(CStr(k)))
    Next k
    Set RowCountsFromNameData = result
End Function

Private Sub TallyStaffPOC(nameData As Object, staffName As String, pocVal As String)
    If Not nameData.Exists(staffName) Then
        Dim d As Object
        Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        d.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
        nameData.Add staffName, d
    End If
    Dim pd As Object
    Set pd = nameData(staffName)
    Dim key As String
    key = pocVal
    If key = "" Then key = "(blank)"
    If pd.Exists(key) Then
        pd(key) = pd(key) + 1
    Else
        pd(key) = 1
    End If
End Sub

Private Function SumDict(d As Object) As Long
    Dim total As Long
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In d.Keys
        total = total + d(k)
    Next k
    SumDict = total
End Function

Private Sub DominantPOC(pocDict As Object, ByRef domPoc As String, ByRef domCount As Long, ByRef totalCount As Long)
    domPoc = ""
    domCount = 0
    totalCount = 0
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In pocDict.Keys
        totalCount = totalCount + pocDict(k)
        If pocDict(k) > domCount Then
            domCount = pocDict(k)
            domPoc = CStr(k)
        End If
    Next k
End Function

Private Function SuggestTeamFromPOC(pocVal As String) As String
    Dim u As String
    u = UCase(Trim(pocVal))

    If u = "TTSH EMERGENCY" Then
        SuggestTeamFromPOC = TEAM_ED_EDFC
    ElseIf u = "TTSH VIRTUAL WARD" Then
        SuggestTeamFromPOC = TEAM_INFLIGHT
    ElseIf Left(u, Len("TTSH@HOME")) = "TTSH@HOME" Then
        SuggestTeamFromPOC = TEAM_INFLIGHT
    ElseIf InStr(u, "NCID") > 0 Then
        SuggestTeamFromPOC = TEAM_NCID_AO
    ElseIf Left(u, Len("ICH WARD")) = "ICH WARD" Then
        SuggestTeamFromPOC = TEAM_ICH_PSO
    Else
        SuggestTeamFromPOC = TEAM_OTHERS
    End If
End Function

' ---- Roster export / import (PART 4.4, 2026-07-30) -------------------------

' Writes the Config sheet's Staff Name / Team roster to a CSV via a SaveAs
' dialog, so the monthly-rotating report can carry one team's roster into
' the next lead's workbook copy without them drifting apart.
Public Sub ExportStaffRoster()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Config sheet does not exist yet. Run CreateConfigSheet (Alt+F8) first.", _
               vbExclamation, "No Config Sheet"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim nameCol As Long, teamCol As Long
    nameCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Staff Name")
    teamCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Team")
    If nameCol = 0 Or teamCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Config sheet is missing the 'Staff Name' / 'Team' headers.", vbExclamation, "Missing Columns"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, nameCol).End(xlUp).Row

    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogSaveAs)
    fd.title = "Export Staff Roster"
    fd.InitialFileName = "FC_Staff_Roster.csv"
    If fd.Show <> -1 Then Exit Sub

    Dim savePath As String
    savePath = fd.SelectedItems(1)

    Dim fnum As Integer
    fnum = FreeFile
    Open savePath For Output As #fnum

    Print #fnum, "Staff Name,Team"

    Dim r As Long, nm As String, tm As String, count As Long
    For r = 2 To lastRow
        nm = Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(r, nameCol).Value))
        tm = Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(r, teamCol).Value))
        If nm <> "" Then
            Print #fnum, CSVQuote(nm) & "," & CSVQuote(tm)
            count = count + 1
        End If
    Next r

    Close #fnum

    Dim plural As String
    If count = 1 Then plural = "y" Else plural = "ies"
    MsgBox count & " staff roster entr" & plural & " exported to:" & vbNewLine & savePath, _
           vbInformation, "Export Complete"
End Sub

' Reads a Staff Name,Team CSV (as written by ExportStaffRoster) via an Open
' dialog, confirms with the user, then REPLACES the current Config roster.
' Quoted fields (e.g. "LIM YONG CHIEW, DESMOND") are parsed correctly.
Public Sub ImportStaffRoster()
    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFilePicker)
    fd.title = "Import Staff Roster"
    fd.Filters.Clear
    fd.Filters.Add "CSV Files", "*.csv"
    If fd.Show <> -1 Then Exit Sub

    Dim filePath As String
    filePath = fd.SelectedItems(1)

    Dim fnum As Integer
    fnum = FreeFile
    Open filePath For Input As #fnum

    Dim lines As New Collection
    Dim ln As String
    Do While Not EOF(fnum)
        Line Input #fnum, ln
        lines.Add ln
    Loop
    Close #fnum

    If lines.Count = 0 Then
        MsgBox "The selected file is empty.", vbExclamation, "Empty File"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim resp As VbMsgBoxResult
    resp = MsgBox("This will REPLACE the current staff roster on the Config sheet with up to " & _
        (lines.Count - 1) & " row(s) from:" & vbNewLine & filePath & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
        "Continue?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion, "Confirm Roster Import")
    If resp = vbNo Then Exit Sub

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        CreateConfigSheet
        Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow >= 2 Then ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, 2)).ClearContents

    Dim i As Long, outRow As Long, loaded As Long, malformed As Long
    outRow = 2
    For i = 1 To lines.Count
        Dim rawLine As String
        rawLine = CStr(lines(i))

        If i = 1 And UCase(Trim(rawLine)) = "STAFF NAME,TEAM" Then GoTo ContinueImportLoop

        Dim fields() As String
        fields = ParseCSVLine(rawLine)

        If (UBound(fields) - LBound(fields) + 1) <> 2 Then
            malformed = malformed + 1
        Else
            Dim nm As String, tm As String
            nm = Trim(fields(0))
            tm = Trim(fields(1))
            If nm = "" Then
                malformed = malformed + 1
            Else
                ws.Cells(outRow, 1).Value = nm
                ws.Cells(outRow, 2).Value = tm
                outRow = outRow + 1
                loaded = loaded + 1
            End If
        End If
ContinueImportLoop:
    Next i

    ws.Columns("A:B").AutoFit

    Dim plural As String
    If loaded = 1 Then plural = "y" Else plural = "ies"
    MsgBox loaded & " roster entr" & plural & " loaded; " & malformed & _
        " malformed row(s) skipped.", vbInformation, "Import Complete"
End Sub

' Quotes a CSV field if it contains a comma, quote, or line break; doubles any
' embedded quotes. Plain fields are left unquoted.
Private Function CSVQuote(s As String) As String
    If InStr(s, ",") > 0 Or InStr(s, """") > 0 Or InStr(s, vbCr) > 0 Or InStr(s, vbLf) > 0 Then
        CSVQuote = """" & Replace(s, """", """""") & """"
    Else
        CSVQuote = s
    End If
End Function

' Parses one CSV line into a 0-based String array, honouring double-quoted
' fields (with "" as an escaped quote) so values like "LIM YONG CHIEW, DESMOND"
' survive a round trip through ExportStaffRoster / ImportStaffRoster.
Private Function ParseCSVLine(ln As String) As String()
    Dim result() As String
    Dim cap As Long
    cap = 10
    ReDim result(0 To cap - 1)
    Dim count As Long
    count = 0

    Dim i As Long, ch As String, field As String, inQuotes As Boolean
    inQuotes = False
    field = ""
    i = 1
    Do While i <= Len(ln)
        ch = Mid(ln, i, 1)
        If inQuotes Then
            If ch = """" Then
                If i < Len(ln) And Mid(ln, i + 1, 1) = """" Then
                    field = field & """"
                    i = i + 1
                Else
                    inQuotes = False
                End If
            Else
                field = field & ch
            End If
        Else
            If ch = """" Then
                inQuotes = True
            ElseIf ch = "," Then
                If count >= cap Then
                    cap = cap * 2
                    ReDim Preserve result(0 To cap - 1)
                End If
                result(count) = field
                count = count + 1
                field = ""
            Else
                field = field & ch
            End If
        End If
        i = i + 1
    Loop

    If count >= cap Then
        cap = cap + 1
        ReDim Preserve result(0 To cap - 1)
    End If
    result(count) = field
    count = count + 1

    ReDim Preserve result(0 To count - 1)
    ParseCSVLine = result
End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "FilterFileA"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' FilterFileA.bas
'
' File A = FC Summary Report. This module covers the early cleaning
' steps that don't depend on the staff roster or any other file:
'
'   Step 1 -- FilterFCMode:     keep only Financial Counselling rows
'                                (drops Shopper mode and anything else)
'   Step 2 -- DeleteCancelledAdmissions: drop Admission Status = "Cancelled"
'
' Later steps (sort/highlight/dedup/EM-EL split) live in
' DeduplicateEncounters.bas and are orchestrated from MainMacro.
'
' Load-filter-write strategy: reads the sheet once into a Variant array,
' compacts matching rows in memory, writes back in one bulk operation.
' ============================================================

Private Const FC_MODE_AH       As String = "Financial Counselling - AH"
Private Const FC_MODE_DOWNTIME As String = "Financial Counselling - Downtime"

Private Const ADM_CANCELLED As String = "Cancelled"

' Step 1 -- keeps only rows where FC Mode is "Financial Counselling - AH" or
' "Financial Counselling - Downtime". Removes Shopper mode and any other
' non-FC mode rows.
Public Function FilterFCMode(ws As Worksheet) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Dim modeCol As Long
    modeCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Mode")
    If modeCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File A is missing the 'FC Mode' column." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the FC Summary Report export.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        FilterFCMode = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    FilterFCMode = True

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    If encCol > 0 Then
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    Else
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, modeCol).End(xlUp).Row
    End If
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Function
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

    ' --- Step 1: Load entire working sheet into memory (one read) ---
    Dim allData As Variant
    allData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    ' --- Step 2: Count rows with an allowed FC Mode ---
    ' Both sides run through NormalizeDashesAndSpaces: the .docx guide writes
    ' "Financial Counselling - AH" with an EN DASH, so a real export using
    ' that character (or an em dash) must still match the plain-hyphen constants.
    Dim keepCount As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim modeVal As String
    Dim modeAHNorm As String, modeDowntimeNorm As String
    modeAHNorm = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(FC_MODE_AH))
    modeDowntimeNorm = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(FC_MODE_DOWNTIME))
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        modeVal = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(CStr(allData(i, modeCol))))
        If modeVal = modeAHNorm Or modeVal = modeDowntimeNorm Then
            keepCount = keepCount + 1
        End If
    Next i

    If keepCount = 0 Then
        ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).ClearContents
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        MsgBox "No Financial Counselling rows found after the FC Mode filter." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the FC Summary Report export.", vbExclamation, "No Data"
        FilterFCMode = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' --- Step 3: Build a compacted array of only the matching rows ---
    Dim filtData() As Variant
    ReDim filtData(1 To keepCount, 1 To lastCol)

    Dim outRow As Long, j As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        modeVal = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(CStr(allData(i, modeCol))))
        If modeVal = modeAHNorm Or modeVal = modeDowntimeNorm Then
            outRow = outRow + 1
            For j = 1 To lastCol
                filtData(outRow, j) = allData(i, j)
            Next j
        End If
    Next i

    ' --- Step 4: Write filtered rows back starting at row 2 (one write) ---
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + keepCount, lastCol)).Value = filtData

    ' --- Step 5: Delete the now-empty tail rows below the new last data row ---
    Dim newLastRow As Long
    newLastRow = 1 + keepCount
    If newLastRow < lastRow Then
        ws.Rows((newLastRow + 1) & ":" & lastRow).Delete
    End If

    Application.StatusBar = "FC Mode filter complete: kept " & keepCount & " rows."
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "Unexpected error during FC Mode filter:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    FilterFCMode = False

End Function

' Step 2 -- deletes rows where Admission Status = "Cancelled".
Public Function DeleteCancelledAdmissions(ws As Worksheet) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Dim admStatCol As Long
    admStatCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Admission Status")
    If admStatCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File A is missing the 'Admission Status' column." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the FC Summary Report export.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        DeleteCancelledAdmissions = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    DeleteCancelledAdmissions = True

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    If encCol > 0 Then
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    Else
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, admStatCol).End(xlUp).Row
    End If
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Function
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

    ' --- Step 1: Load entire working sheet into memory (one read) ---
    Dim allData As Variant
    allData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    ' --- Step 2: Count rows whose Admission Status is NOT "Cancelled" ---
    Dim keepCount As Long
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If UCase(Trim(CStr(allData(i, admStatCol)))) <> UCase(ADM_CANCELLED) Then
            keepCount = keepCount + 1
        End If
    Next i

    If keepCount = lastRow - 1 Then
        ' Nothing to remove
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        Application.StatusBar = "Cancelled-admission filter complete: no Cancelled rows found."
        Exit Function
    End If

    If keepCount = 0 Then
        ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).ClearContents
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        MsgBox "All rows have Admission Status = 'Cancelled'." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the FC Summary Report export.", vbExclamation, "No Data"
        DeleteCancelledAdmissions = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' --- Step 3: Build a compacted array of only the non-Cancelled rows ---
    Dim filtData() As Variant
    ReDim filtData(1 To keepCount, 1 To lastCol)

    Dim outRow As Long, j As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If UCase(Trim(CStr(allData(i, admStatCol)))) <> UCase(ADM_CANCELLED) Then
            outRow = outRow + 1
            For j = 1 To lastCol
                filtData(outRow, j) = allData(i, j)
            Next j
        End If
    Next i

    ' --- Step 4: Write filtered rows back starting at row 2 (one write) ---
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + keepCount, lastCol)).Value = filtData

    ' --- Step 5: Delete the now-empty tail rows below the new last data row ---
    Dim newLastRow As Long
    newLastRow = 1 + keepCount
    If newLastRow < lastRow Then
        ws.Rows((newLastRow + 1) & ":" & lastRow).Delete
    End If

    Application.StatusBar = "Cancelled-admission filter complete: removed " & (lastRow - 1 - keepCount) & " row(s)."
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "Unexpected error during Cancelled-admission filter:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    DeleteCancelledAdmissions = False

End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "MainMacro"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' MainMacro.bas
'
' Entry point: GenerateFCCompletionReport (run via Alt+F8).
' Orchestrates the full pipeline:
'   1. FilePickerForm -- select File A (required) and File B (optional)
'   2. Load staff roster + NCID EL Point of Care list from Config sheet
'   3. Clean File A (FC Mode filter, cancel filter, dedup), snapshotting row/
'      encounter counts along the way for the Summary sheet reconciliation
'      waterfall (PART 3.3, 2026-07-30)
'   4. Roster coverage guard (PART 4.1, 2026-07-30) -- measures what fraction
'      of encounters map to a named team; warns or aborts before an empty/
'      unmatched roster silently reports 100% "Others"
'   5. Clean File B (FC Mode filter, Missed FC filter, cancel/planned, EDVW
'      flag) -- SKIPPED entirely if File B was not provided
'   6. Build output workbook (EM/EL split, Summary, Methodology, Roster Check)
'   7. Close input files, show success summary
'
' Step numbering is computed dynamically (stepNum/totalSteps) rather than
' hardcoded, so the progress bar adapts automatically to whether File B's
' four cleaning steps are present.
' ============================================================

Public Sub GenerateFCCompletionReport()

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    ' ---- Step 0: File picker ----
    Dim picker As FilePickerForm
    Set picker = New FilePickerForm
    If Not picker.ShowFilePicker Then Exit Sub

    Dim wbA As Workbook, wbB As Workbook
    Set wbA = picker.SelectedFileA
    Set wbB = picker.SelectedFileB

    Dim hasFileB As Boolean
    hasFileB = Not (wbB Is Nothing)

    Dim wsA As Worksheet, wsB As Worksheet
    Set wsA = wbA.Sheets(1)
    If hasFileB Then Set wsB = wbB.Sheets(1)

    ' ---- Show progress (9 steps always + 4 more if File B is present) ----
    Dim totalSteps As Long
    totalSteps = 9
    If hasFileB Then totalSteps = totalSteps + 4
    ProgressForm.ShowProgress totalSteps

    Dim stepNum As Long
    stepNum = 0

    ' ---- Load staff roster + NCID EL Point of Care list ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Loading staff roster and NCID Point of Care list"
    Dim roster As Object
    Set roster = LoadStaffRoster()
    Dim ncidPocList As Object
    Set ncidPocList = LoadNCIDPointOfCareList()

    ' ---- Clean File A ----
    ' Waterfall snapshot: rows as loaded + distinct encounters before the FC
    ' Mode filter (PART 2.4 / 3.3, 2026-07-30).
    Dim rowsLoadedA As Long
    rowsLoadedA = CountDataRows(wsA)
    Dim encSetBeforeMode As Object
    Set encSetBeforeMode = GetDistinctEncounterSet(wsA)
    Dim blankEncBeforeMode As Long
    blankEncBeforeMode = CountBlankEncounterRows(wsA)

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- filtering FC Mode"
    If Not FilterFCMode(wsA) Then GoTo Cleanup

    Dim rowsAfterMode As Long
    rowsAfterMode = CountDataRows(wsA)
    ' Encounters lost entirely to the FC Mode filter (PART 2.4): distinct
    ' real (non-blank) encounter numbers gone, PLUS at most 1 more if any
    ' blank-encounter row (e.g. a Shopper-mode form, which some eFC exports
    ' submit with no Encounter Number at all) was dropped -- a blank
    ' encounter number can't be split into separate real encounters, so all
    ' such rows lost this way count as one indeterminate "encounter", not one
    ' each.
    Dim encountersLostToModeFilter As Long
    encountersLostToModeFilter = CountKeysNotIn(encSetBeforeMode, GetDistinctEncounterSet(wsA))
    If CountBlankEncounterRows(wsA) < blankEncBeforeMode Then
        encountersLostToModeFilter = encountersLostToModeFilter + 1
    End If

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- removing cancelled admissions"
    If Not DeleteCancelledAdmissions(wsA) Then GoTo Cleanup

    Dim rowsAfterCancelled As Long
    rowsAfterCancelled = CountDataRows(wsA)
    Dim uniqueEncountersBeforeDedup As Long
    uniqueEncountersBeforeDedup = GetDistinctEncounterSet(wsA).Count

    ' ---- Deduplicate File A ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- adding priority column"
    AddPriorityColumn wsA

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- highlighting duplicate encounters"
    MarkDuplicateEncounters wsA

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- resolving duplicates"
    Dim voidedOnlyCount As Long
    Dim dupGroupsResolved As Long
    Dim dupRowsRemoved As Long
    Dim inflightExceptionApplied As Long
    Dim inflightExceptionBlocked As Long
    If Not ResolveDuplicateEncounters(wsA, roster, voidedOnlyCount, _
            dupGroupsResolved, dupRowsRemoved, _
            inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked) Then GoTo Cleanup

    ' ---- Waterfall dictionary (PART 3.3) -- consumed by BuildOutput.bas's
    ' WriteReconciliationWaterfall on the Summary sheet.
    Dim waterfall As Object
    Set waterfall = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    waterfall("RowsLoaded") = rowsLoadedA
    waterfall("RowsAfterModeFilter") = rowsAfterMode
    waterfall("RowsAfterCancelledFilter") = rowsAfterCancelled
    waterfall("UniqueEncounters") = uniqueEncountersBeforeDedup
    waterfall("DuplicateGroupsResolved") = dupGroupsResolved
    waterfall("DuplicateRowsRemoved") = dupRowsRemoved
    waterfall("EncountersLostToModeFilter") = encountersLostToModeFilter

    ' ---- Roster coverage guard (PART 4.1, 2026-07-30) ----
    ' Run after File A cleaning/dedup, before BuildOutputWorkbook, so an
    ' empty/unmatched roster is caught here rather than silently producing a
    ' Summary claiming 100% of CCFs were closed by "Others".
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Checking staff roster coverage"
    Dim unmatchedNames As Object
    Dim rosterCoverage As Double
    rosterCoverage = ComputeRosterCoverage(wsA, roster, unmatchedNames)

    Dim suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean
    suppressTeamBlocks = False

    If rosterCoverage = 0 Then
        Dim resp As VbMsgBoxResult
        resp = MsgBox("The staff roster (Config sheet) is empty, or doesn't match any names in " & _
            "this export." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
            "'Who Closed the CCF' and all four numerator indicators (FC created by EDFC, CCF " & _
            "closed by EDFC/Inflight/NCID AO) will be UNAVAILABLE for this report." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
            "Continue and produce completion statistics only?", vbYesNo + vbExclamation, _
            "Staff Roster Not Matched")
        If resp = vbNo Then GoTo Cleanup
        suppressTeamBlocks = True
    ElseIf rosterCoverage < 0.7 Then
        MsgBox "Staff roster coverage is low: only " & Format(rosterCoverage, "0.0%") & _
            " of encounters matched a named team." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
            "The report will still be produced, but unmatched staff names will be listed on the " & _
            "Summary sheet (largest first) so you can see which names to add to the Config roster.", _
            vbInformation, "Low Roster Coverage"
    End If

    ' ---- Clean File B (skipped entirely if not provided) ----
    If hasFileB Then
        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- filtering FC Mode"
        If Not FilterFCModeIfPresent(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- keeping Missed FC rows"
        If Not KeepOnlyMissedFC(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- removing cancelled/planned"
        If Not DeleteCancelledOrPlanned(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- flagging EDVW discharges"
        FlagEDVWDischarges wsB
    End If

    ' ---- Build output ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Building output workbook"
    Dim outputOK As Boolean
    outputOK = BuildOutputWorkbook(wsA, wsB, roster, ncidPocList, _
        picker.MissedFCManualCount, inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked, _
        waterfall, rosterCoverage, unmatchedNames, suppressTeamBlocks)

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Done"

    ' ---- Cleanup: close input files ----
    On Error Resume Next
    wbA.Close SaveChanges:=False
    If hasFileB Then wbB.Close SaveChanges:=False
    On Error GoTo 0

    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    Application.StatusBar = False

    If outputOK Then
        Dim msg As String
        msg = "FC Completion Report generated successfully." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
              "Duplicate encounters resolved: " & dupGroupsResolved & _
              " (" & dupRowsRemoved & " row(s) removed)" & vbNewLine & _
              "Voided/Deleted-only encounters (counted in denominator, REVERT B): " & voidedOnlyCount & vbNewLine & _
              "Encounters lost entirely to the FC Mode filter (e.g. Shopper-only): " & _
              encountersLostToModeFilter & vbNewLine & _
              "Inflight duplicate exception applied: " & inflightExceptionApplied & _
              " group(s); blocked by the priority<=2 guard: " & inflightExceptionBlocked & " group(s)"
        If suppressTeamBlocks Then
            msg = msg & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                  "Staff roster coverage: 0% -- 'Who Closed the CCF' and numerator indicators were " & _
                  "suppressed this run."
        Else
            msg = msg & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                  "Staff roster coverage: " & Format(rosterCoverage, "0.0%")
        End If
        If Not hasFileB Then
            msg = msg & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                  "File B was not provided -- Missed FC count used manual entry: " & _
                  picker.MissedFCManualCount
        End If
        MsgBox msg, vbInformation, "Complete"
    Else
        MsgBox "Report generation encountered an error. Check the output workbook " & _
               "(if open) for partial results.", vbExclamation, "Warning"
    End If

    Exit Sub

Cleanup:
    On Error Resume Next
    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    wbA.Close SaveChanges:=False
    If hasFileB Then wbB.Close SaveChanges:=False
    Application.StatusBar = False
    On Error GoTo 0
    Exit Sub

ErrHandler:
    On Error Resume Next
    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    Application.StatusBar = False
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    On Error GoTo 0
    MsgBox "Unexpected error:" & vbNewLine & _

## 2. File A -- Cleaning and Deduplication

The tool processes File A in this order:

1. **Remove non-FC rows.** Keep only rows where FC Mode is "Financial Counselling -
   AH" or "Financial Counselling - Downtime". (Removes Shopper-mode and other
   irrelevant rows.)

2. **Remove cancelled admissions.** Any row where Admission Status = "Cancelled" is
   dropped.

3. **Rank each remaining row by FC Status**, using this priority order (1 = best,
   higher number = worse):

   | Priority | FC Status |
   |---|---|
   | 1 | Completed |
   | 2 | Acknowledgement by other means |
   | 3 | Attempted - Virtual FC Completed, pending signature |
   | 4 | Attempted - patient/NOK declines to sign |
   | 5 | Attempted - Patient is unable to sign |
   | 6 | Attempted - unable to complete |
   | 98 | Anything else not explicitly listed above -- Draft variants, blanks, typos, new eFC statuses. Still IN the denominator (not completed), NOT excluded. |
   | 99 | Voided / Deleted ONLY (matched by substring, e.g. "Voided", "Deleted by Admin") -- excluded from the denominator entirely (see step 8). |

   The distinct FC Status text values landing on priority 98 are collected and
   printed as a warning block on the Summary sheet each run, so a typo or a
   brand-new eFC status is visible instead of silently shrinking the
   denominator.

4. **Group rows by Encounter Number** and sort each group so the most recently
   created CCF is last.

5. **Highlight duplicate encounter numbers in red** -- this is just a visual aid so
   staff can see at a glance which encounters had more than one FC ID.

6. **Pick one row to keep per encounter.** For each encounter with more than one FC
   ID:
   - The default rule is **plain lowest-priority-wins**: across ALL candidate rows,
     keep the one with the best (lowest) priority number from the table above. If
     there's a tie, keep the one with the **larger FC ID** (i.e. the more recently
     created one).
   - The **Inflight exception** only overrides this default when BOTH hold:
     a) at least one of the *non*-Inflight rows in the group was created by an
        **ED/EDFC** staff member (per the staff roster), AND
     b) the winner that would result from setting the Inflight row(s) aside has
        priority 1 or 2 (Completed / Acknowledgement by other means).
     When both hold, the Inflight-created row(s) are set aside and the winner is
     picked from the remaining non-Inflight candidates instead. If either
     condition fails, the plain lowest-priority rule from above stands -- the
     Inflight row is treated like any other candidate.
   - If an encounter only has one FC ID to begin with, that row is always kept
     (even if its priority is 99).
   - The tool counts how many encounter groups used the Inflight exception, and
     how many were blocked by the priority<=2 guard (fell back to the plain
     rule) -- both counts are reported in the final summary dialog and on the
     Methodology sheet.

7. **Delete every row that wasn't kept.** This replaces the old manual "review
   duplicates and delete" step entirely -- the tool does it automatically using the
   rule above.

8. **Encounters where the only surviving FC ID is Voided/Deleted (priority 99)**
   -- **REVISED 2026-07-30 (Q4 reopened):** these are now counted IN the
   denominator and IN "not completed", with their own "Voided/Deleted only"
   row on the Summary sheet (this matches the manual report -- 56 this month:

Public Function BuildOutputWorkbook(fileAws As Worksheet, fileBws As Worksheet, _
        roster As Object, ncidPocList As Object, missedFCManualCount As Long, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long, _
        waterfall As Object, _
        rosterCoverage As Double, unmatchedNames As Object, suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    BuildOutputWorkbook = True

    Dim hasFileB As Boolean
    hasFileB = Not (fileBws Is Nothing)

    ' ---- Validate required File A columns ----
    Dim encCol As Long, admTypeCol As Long, fcStatusCol As Long
    Dim createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long, priCol As Long, pocCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    admTypeCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Admission Type")
    fcStatusCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Status")
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Created By")
    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
    priCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "PRIORITISE")
    pocCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Point of Care")

    If encCol = 0 Or admTypeCol = 0 Or fcStatusCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File A is missing a required column (Encounter Number, " & _
               "Admission Type, or FC Status).", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        BuildOutputWorkbook = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' ---- Read File A data ----
    Dim aLastRow As Long, aLastCol As Long
    aLastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    aLastCol = fileAws.Cells(1, fileAws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Dim aData As Variant
    aData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(1, 1), fileAws.Cells(aLastRow, aLastCol)).Value

    ' ---- Build expanded array with extra columns ----
    Dim outCols As Long
    outCols = aLastCol + 4
    Dim ccfCloserCol As Long, ccfTeamCol As Long, looksWrongCol As Long, ncidWardCol As Long
    ccfCloserCol = aLastCol + 1
    ccfTeamCol = aLastCol + 2
    looksWrongCol = aLastCol + 3
    ncidWardCol = aLastCol + 4

    Dim fullData() As Variant
    ReDim fullData(1 To aLastRow, 1 To outCols)

    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    For i = 1 To aLastRow
        For j = 1 To aLastCol
            fullData(i, j) = aData(i, j)
        Next j
    Next i

    fullData(1, ccfCloserCol) = "CCF Closed By"
    fullData(1, ccfTeamCol) = "CCF Closer Team"
    fullData(1, looksWrongCol) = "Looks Wrong"
    fullData(1, ncidWardCol) = "NCID Ward"

    ' secArr(i) = section for fullData row i: SEC_EM, SEC_EL, or 0 (neither).
    Dim secArr() As Long
    ReDim secArr(1 To aLastRow)

    ' ---- Compute extra columns + stats in one pass ----
    Dim greenCt(1 To 2) As Long, pinkCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim ltGreenCt(1 To 2) As Long, orangeCt(1 To 2) As Long, draftCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim encCt(1 To 2) As Long, voidCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim blankCCF(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim edInit(1 To 2) As Long, edFull(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim inflFull(1 To 2) As Long, ncidFull(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim otherEncCount As Long

    ' NCID ward subset (of EL) -- PART 3.1
    Dim ncidEnc As Long, ncidGreen As Long, ncidPink As Long, ncidLtGreen As Long
    Dim ncidOrange As Long, ncidDraft As Long, ncidVoid As Long, ncidBlankCCF As Long
    Dim ncidEdInit As Long, ncidEdFull As Long, ncidInflFull As Long, ncidNcidFull As Long
    Dim ncidTeams As Object
    Set ncidTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    InitTeamCounts ncidTeams

    Dim emTeams As Object, elTeams As Object
    Set emTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set elTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    InitTeamCounts emTeams
    InitTeamCounts elTeams

    Dim unrecognisedStatuses As Object
    Set unrecognisedStatuses = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    unrecognisedStatuses.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim unmatchedNCIDWards As Object
    Set unmatchedNCIDWards = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    unmatchedNCIDWards.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    For i = 2 To aLastRow
        ' Resolve CCF closer
        Dim latestCCF As String
        latestCCF = ""
        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then latestCCF = CellStr(fullData(i, latestCCFCol))

        Dim createdBy As String
        createdBy = ""
        If createdByCol > 0 Then createdBy = CellStr(fullData(i, createdByCol))

        Dim ccfCloser As String
        Dim usedFallback As Boolean
        usedFallback = False
        If latestCCF <> "" Then
            ccfCloser = latestCCF
        ElseIf createdBy <> "" Then
            ccfCloser = createdBy
            usedFallback = True
        Else
            ccfCloser = ""
            usedFallback = True
        End If

        Dim team As String
        team = GetStaffTeam(roster, ccfCloser)

        fullData(i, ccfCloserCol) = ccfCloser
        fullData(i, ccfTeamCol) = team

        ' NCID Ward informational column + unmatched-"NCID"-value warning (PART 3.1)
        Dim pocValRaw As String
        pocValRaw = ""
        If pocCol > 0 Then pocValRaw = CellStr(fullData(i, pocCol))

        Dim isNCIDWard As Boolean
        isNCIDWard = (pocValRaw <> "" And ncidPocList.Exists(pocValRaw))
        If isNCIDWard Then
            fullData(i, ncidWardCol) = "Yes"
        Else
            fullData(i, ncidWardCol) = "No"
        End If

        If pocValRaw <> "" And InStr(UCase(pocValRaw), "NCID") > 0 And Not ncidPocList.Exists(pocValRaw) Then
            If unmatchedNCIDWards.Exists(pocValRaw) Then
                unmatchedNCIDWards(pocValRaw) = unmatchedNCIDWards(pocValRaw) + 1
            Else
                unmatchedNCIDWards(pocValRaw) = 1
            End If
        End If

        ' Determine section: SEC_EM, SEC_EL (Admission Type alone -- Revert A), or 0 = neither.
        Dim admType As String
        admType = UCase(CellStr(fullData(i, admTypeCol)))

        Dim sec As Long
        If admType = UCase(ADM_EMERGENCY) Then
            sec = SEC_EM
        ElseIf IsElectiveAdmType(admType) Then
            sec = SEC_EL
        Else
            sec = 0
            otherEncCount = otherEncCount + 1
        End If
        secArr(i) = sec

        ' Looks Wrong flag
        If sec = SEC_EM And team = TEAM_NCID_AO Then
            fullData(i, looksWrongCol) = "Check"
        ElseIf sec = SEC_EL And (team = TEAM_ED_EDFC Or team = TEAM_INFLIGHT) Then
            fullData(i, looksWrongCol) = "Check"
        End If

        ' Stats (EM and EL only)
        If sec > 0 Then
            Dim pri As Long
            If priCol > 0 Then
                If IsNumeric(fullData(i, priCol)) Then
                    pri = CLng(fullData(i, priCol))
                Else
                    pri = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol)))
                End If
            Else
                pri = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol)))
            End If

            encCt(sec) = encCt(sec) + 1
            ClassifyIntoBand pri, greenCt(sec), pinkCt(sec), ltGreenCt(sec), orangeCt(sec), draftCt(sec), voidCt(sec)

            If pri = 98 Then
                ' Known "Draft" family variants (Draft, Draft (CCF Generated),
                ' Draft (ETBS Generated), ...) are an EXPECTED priority-98
                ' outcome, not an anomaly -- only genuinely unexpected text
                ' (blank, typo, brand-new eFC status) goes into the warning
                ' dictionary. Matches the real export: "Draft"/"Draft (CCF
                ' Generated)"/"Draft (ETBS Generated)" are common and normal;

                If statusText = "" Then statusText = "(blank)"

16	'                                     (does not remove rows -- everything left
17	'                                     after Step 3 counts toward Missed FC)
18	'

20	' compacts matching rows in memory, writes back in one bulk operation.

22

24	Private Const FC_MODE_DOWNTIME As String = "Financial Counselling - Downtime"
25

33	' rows (same allowlist as File A). If the column doesn't exist, this is a no-op

35	Public Function FilterFCModeIfPresent(ws As Worksheet) As Boolean
36	
37	    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
38	
39	    Dim modeCol As Long
40	    modeCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Mode")
41	    If modeCol = 0 Then
42	        FilterFCModeIfPresent = True
43	        Exit Function   ' no FC Mode column on this export -- nothing to filter
44	    End If
45	
46	    Dim encCol As Long
47	    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
48	
49	    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
50	    If encCol > 0 Then
51	        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
52	    Else
53	        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, modeCol).End(xlUp).Row
54	    End If
55	    If lastRow < 2 Then
56	        FilterFCModeIfPresent = True
57	        Exit Function
58	    End If
59	    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
60	
61	    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
62	    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
63	
64	    Dim allData As Variant
65	    allData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value
66	
67	    ' Both sides run through NormalizeDashesAndSpaces -- see FilterFileA.FilterFCMode
68	    ' for why (the .docx guide's FC Mode text uses an en dash, not a hyphen).
69	    Dim keepCount As Long
70	    Dim i As Long
71	    Dim modeVal As String
72	    Dim modeAHNorm As String, modeDowntimeNorm As String
73	    modeAHNorm = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(FC_MODE_AH))
74	    modeDowntimeNorm = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(FC_MODE_DOWNTIME))
75	    For i = 2 To lastRow
76	        modeVal = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(CStr(allData(i, modeCol))))
77	        If modeVal = modeAHNorm Or modeVal = modeDowntimeNorm Then
78	            keepCount = keepCount + 1

91	        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
92	        Application.ScreenUpdating = True

94	               "Check the Inflight Missed FC Report export.", vbExclamation, "No Data"
95	        FilterFCModeIfPresent = False
96	        Exit Function
97	    End If
98	
99	    Dim filtData() As Variant
100	    ReDim filtData(1 To keepCount, 1 To lastCol)
101	
102	    Dim outRow As Long, j As Long
103	    For i = 2 To lastRow
104	        modeVal = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(CStr(allData(i, modeCol))))
105	        If modeVal = modeAHNorm Or modeVal = modeDowntimeNorm Then
106	            outRow = outRow + 1
107	            For j = 1 To lastCol
108	                filtData(outRow, j) = allData(i, j)
109	            Next j
110	        End If
111	    Next i
112	
113	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + keepCount, lastCol)).Value = filtData
114	
115	    Dim newLastRow As Long
116	    newLastRow = 1 + keepCount
117	    If newLastRow < lastRow Then
118	        ws.Rows((newLastRow + 1) & ":" & lastRow).Delete
119	    End If
120	
121	    Application.StatusBar = "File B FC Mode filter complete: kept " & keepCount & " rows."
122	    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
123	    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
124	    FilterFCModeIfPresent = True
125	    Exit Function
126

129	    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

' File B = Inflight Missed FC Report (Missed FC indicator ticked).

'                                     after Step 3 counts toward Missed FC)
'
' Load-filter-write strategy: reads the sheet once into a Variant array,
' compacts matching rows in memory, writes back in one bulk operation.
' ============================================================

Private Const FC_MODE_AH       As String = "Financial Counselling - AH"
Private Const FC_MODE_DOWNTIME As String = "Financial Counselling - Downtime"

Private Const ADM_CANCELLED As String = "Cancelled"
Private Const ADM_PLANNED   As String = "Planned"

Private Const EDVW_POINT_OF_CARE   As String = "TTSH Virtual Ward"
Private Const EDVW_ACCOMMODATION   As String = "EDVW"

' Step 1 -- if File B has an "FC Mode" column, keep only Financial Counselling
' rows (same allowlist as File A). If the column doesn't exist, this is a no-op
' -- CLAUDE.md notes the Inflight FC Report may not include FC Mode at all.
Public Function FilterFCModeIfPresent(ws As Worksheet) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Dim modeCol As Long
    modeCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Mode")
    If modeCol = 0 Then
        FilterFCModeIfPresent = True
        Exit Function   ' no FC Mode column on this export -- nothing to filter
    End If

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    If encCol > 0 Then
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    Else
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, modeCol).End(xlUp).Row
    End If
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        FilterFCModeIfPresent = True
        Exit Function
    End If
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

    Dim allData As Variant
    allData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    ' Both sides run through NormalizeDashesAndSpaces -- see FilterFileA.FilterFCMode
    ' for why (the .docx guide's FC Mode text uses an en dash, not a hyphen).
    Dim keepCount As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim modeVal As String
    Dim modeAHNorm As String, modeDowntimeNorm As String
    modeAHNorm = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(FC_MODE_AH))
    modeDowntimeNorm = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(FC_MODE_DOWNTIME))
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        modeVal = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(CStr(allData(i, modeCol))))
        If modeVal = modeAHNorm Or modeVal = modeDowntimeNorm Then
            keepCount = keepCount + 1
        End If
    Next i

    If keepCount = lastRow - 1 Then
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        FilterFCModeIfPresent = True
        Exit Function   ' nothing to remove
    End If

    If keepCount = 0 Then
        ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).ClearContents
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        MsgBox "No Financial Counselling rows found in File B after the FC Mode filter." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the Inflight Missed FC Report export.", vbExclamation, "No Data"
        FilterFCModeIfPresent = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim filtData() As Variant
    ReDim filtData(1 To keepCount, 1 To lastCol)

    Dim outRow As Long, j As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        modeVal = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(CStr(allData(i, modeCol))))
        If modeVal = modeAHNorm Or modeVal = modeDowntimeNorm Then
            outRow = outRow + 1
            For j = 1 To lastCol
                filtData(outRow, j) = allData(i, j)
            Next j
        End If
    Next i

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + keepCount, lastCol)).Value = filtData

    Dim newLastRow As Long
    newLastRow = 1 + keepCount
    If newLastRow < lastRow Then
        ws.Rows((newLastRow + 1) & ":" & lastRow).Delete
    End If

    Application.StatusBar = "File B FC Mode filter complete: kept " & keepCount & " rows."
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    FilterFCModeIfPresent = True
    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "Unexpected error during File B FC Mode filter:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    FilterFCModeIfPresent = False

End Function

' Step 2 -- keeps only rows where "Missed FC" = "Yes". The Inflight Missed FC
' Report should already be exported with this indicator ticked, but this is a
' defensive filter in case the export includes other rows too.
Public Function KeepOnlyMissedFC(ws As Worksheet) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Dim missedCol As Long
    missedCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Missed FC")
    If missedCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File B is missing the 'Missed FC' column." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the Inflight Missed FC Report export.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        KeepOnlyMissedFC = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    KeepOnlyMissedFC = True

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    If encCol > 0 Then
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    Else
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, missedCol).End(xlUp).Row
    End If
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Function
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

    Dim allData As Variant
    allData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    Dim keepCount As Long
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If UCase(Trim(CStr(allData(i, missedCol)))) = "YES" Then
            keepCount = keepCount + 1
        End If
    Next i

    If keepCount = 0 Then
        ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).ClearContents
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        MsgBox "No rows with Missed FC = 'Yes' found in File B." & vbNewLine & _
               "Re-export with the Missed FC indicator ticked, or use the manual " & _
               "eFC dashboard workaround export.", vbExclamation, "No Data"
        KeepOnlyMissedFC = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim filtData() As Variant
    ReDim filtData(1 To keepCount, 1 To lastCol)

    Dim outRow As Long, j As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If UCase(Trim(CStr(allData(i, missedCol)))) = "YES" Then
            outRow = outRow + 1
            For j = 1 To lastCol
                filtData(outRow, j) = allData(i, j)
            Next j
        End If
    Next i

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + keepCount, lastCol)).Value = filtData

    Dim newLastRow As Long
    newLastRow = 1 + keepCount
    If newLastRow < lastRow Then
        ws.Rows((newLastRow + 1) & ":" & lastRow).Delete
    End If

    Application.StatusBar = "Missed FC filter complete: kept " & keepCount & " rows."
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "Unexpected error during Missed FC filter:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    KeepOnlyMissedFC = False

End Function

' Step 3 -- deletes rows where Admission Status = "Cancelled" or "Planned".
' Cancelled = upstream cancellation; Planned = patient never actualised in ward.
Public Function DeleteCancelledOrPlanned(ws As Worksheet) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Dim admStatCol As Long
    admStatCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Admission Status")
    If admStatCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File B is missing the 'Admission Status' column." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the Inflight Missed FC Report export.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        DeleteCancelledOrPlanned = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    DeleteCancelledOrPlanned = True

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    If encCol > 0 Then
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    Else
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, admStatCol).End(xlUp).Row
    End If
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Function
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

    Dim allData As Variant
    allData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    Dim keepCount As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim admVal As String
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        admVal = UCase(Trim(CStr(allData(i, admStatCol))))
        If admVal <> UCase(ADM_CANCELLED) And admVal <> UCase(ADM_PLANNED) Then
            keepCount = keepCount + 1
        End If
    Next i

    If keepCount = lastRow - 1 Then
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        Application.StatusBar = "Cancelled/Planned filter complete: no matching rows found."
        Exit Function
    End If

    If keepCount = 0 Then
        ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).ClearContents
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        MsgBox "All rows in File B have Admission Status = 'Cancelled' or 'Planned'." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the Inflight Missed FC Report export.", vbExclamation, "No Data"
        DeleteCancelledOrPlanned = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim filtData() As Variant
    ReDim filtData(1 To keepCount, 1 To lastCol)

    Dim outRow As Long, j As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        admVal = UCase(Trim(CStr(allData(i, admStatCol))))
        If admVal <> UCase(ADM_CANCELLED) And admVal <> UCase(ADM_PLANNED) Then
            outRow = outRow + 1
            For j = 1 To lastCol
                filtData(outRow, j) = allData(i, j)
            Next j
        End If
    Next i

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + keepCount, lastCol)).Value = filtData

    Dim newLastRow As Long
    newLastRow = 1 + keepCount
    If newLastRow < lastRow Then
        ws.Rows((newLastRow + 1) & ":" & lastRow).Delete
    End If

    Application.StatusBar = "Cancelled/Planned filter complete: removed " & (lastRow - 1 - keepCount) & " row(s)."
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "Unexpected error during Cancelled/Planned filter:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    DeleteCancelledOrPlanned = False

End Function

' Step 4 -- adds an informational "EDVW Discharge" column flagging rows where
' Point Of Care = "TTSH Virtual Ward" and Accommodation Code = "EDVW". This is
' label-only: matching rows are NOT removed or excluded -- everything left
' after Step 3 still counts toward the Missed FC total. Staff use this column
' to see how many missed cases were EDVW short-stay discharges.
'
' If either source column is absent from this export, the column is not added
' at all (BuildOutput must handle "EDVW Discharge" being absent via
' FindColByHeader returning 0).
Public Sub FlagEDVWDischarges(ws As Worksheet)

    Dim pocCol As Long, accomCol As Long
    pocCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Point Of Care")
    ' The real export misspells this header as "Accomodation Code" (one "m") --
    ' try the correct spelling first, then the misspelling (1.3, 2026-07-30).
    accomCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Accommodation Code")
    If accomCol = 0 Then accomCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Accomodation Code")

    If pocCol = 0 Or accomCol = 0 Then
        Application.StatusBar = "EDVW discharge flag skipped: 'Point Of Care' / 'Accommodation Code' " & _
            "column not found on this export."
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    If encCol > 0 Then
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    Else
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, pocCol).End(xlUp).Row
    End If
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Dim flagCol As Long
    flagCol = lastCol + 1
    ws.Cells(1, flagCol).Value = "EDVW Discharge"

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    Dim pocData As Variant, accomData As Variant
    pocData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, pocCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, pocCol)).Value
    accomData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, accomCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, accomCol)).Value

    Dim flagData() As Variant
    ReDim flagData(1 To lastRow - 1, 1 To 1)

    Dim i As Long
    Dim pocVal As String, accomVal As String
    For i = 1 To lastRow - 1
        If lastRow = 2 Then
            pocVal = UCase(Trim(CStr(pocData)))
            accomVal = UCase(Trim(CStr(accomData)))
        Else
            pocVal = UCase(Trim(CStr(pocData(i, 1))))
            accomVal = UCase(Trim(CStr(accomData(i, 1))))
        End If

        If pocVal = UCase(EDVW_POINT_OF_CARE) And accomVal = UCase(EDVW_ACCOMMODATION) Then
            flagData(i, 1) = "Yes"
        Else
            flagData(i, 1) = ""
        End If
    Next i

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, flagCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, flagCol)).Value = flagData

    Application.StatusBar = "EDVW discharge flag added."
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

End Sub
