    splitSum = emEnc + elEnc + otherEncCount
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Check: EM (" & emEnc & ") + EL (" & elEnc & ") + neither (" & _
        otherEncCount & ") = " & splitSum & " vs. encounters carried forward (" & uniqueEnc & ")"
    If splitSum <> uniqueEnc Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "MISMATCH -- there is a bug in the counting logic, report this."
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Bold = True
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(0, 128, 0)
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "OK -- balances."
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Color = RGB(0, 128, 0)
    End If
    r = r + 2
End Sub

' ---- Summary sheet -------------------------------------------------------

' Six colour bands: Green / Pink / Light Green / Orange / White-none (Draft,
' priority 98) / Voided-Deleted (priority 99, REVERT B -- back IN the
' denominator and "not completed", 2026-07-30) / Grey (Missed FC). A "Not
' completed (total)" subtotal (Orange + Draft + Voided + Missed) keeps the
' single headline figure available.
Private Sub WriteSummaryBlock(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, _
        title As String, encCount As Long, missedCount As Long, missedSourceLabel As String, _
        greenCt As Long, pinkCt As Long, ltGreenCt As Long, orangeCt As Long, draftCt As Long, voidedCt As Long, _
        teamD As Object, blankCCFCt As Long, _
        edInit As Long, edFull As Long, inflFull As Long, ncidFull As Long, _
        suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean)

    Dim denom As Long
    denom = encCount + missedCount
    Dim smallDenom As Boolean
    smallDenom = (denom < 30)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = title
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Denominator: " & denom & " encounters"
    If missedCount > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = ws.Cells(r, 1).Value & _
            " (" & encCount & " from FC Summary + " & missedCount & " missed FC, source: " & _
            missedSourceLabel & ")"
    End If
    r = r + 1
    If smallDenom Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "n too small for percentages (n < 30) -- counts only below."
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 1
    End If
    r = r + 1

    ' ---- Completion status table (six colour bands) ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Completion Status"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ' Green (priority 1-2)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Completed with written acknowledgement"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = greenCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, greenCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(146, 208, 80)
    r = r + 1

    ' Pink (priority 3)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF explained but not signed"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = pinkCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, pinkCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 192, 203)
    r = r + 1

    ' Light Green (priority 4-5)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Attempted, no further follow-up"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = ltGreenCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, ltGreenCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(198, 239, 206)
    r = r + 1

    ' Orange (priority 6)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC not completed"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = orangeCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, orangeCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 192, 0)
    r = r + 1

    ' White/none (priority 98 -- Draft variants, blanks, unrecognised statuses)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Draft only -- no FC outcome"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = draftCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, draftCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous
    r = r + 1

    ' Voided/Deleted only (priority 99) -- REVERT B, 2026-07-30: counted IN
    ' the denominator and IN "not completed" now, not excluded. Uncoloured.
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Voided/Deleted only"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = voidedCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, voidedCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous
    r = r + 1

    ' Grey (File B / manual entry -- missed FC, no FC ID ever created)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Missed FC -- no FC ID created"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = missedCount
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, missedCount, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(217, 217, 217)
    r = r + 1

    ' Not completed (total) -- Orange + Draft + Voided + Missed.
    Dim notCompletedTotal As Long
    notCompletedTotal = orangeCt + draftCt + voidedCt + missedCount
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Not completed (total)"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = notCompletedTotal
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Italic = True
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, notCompletedTotal, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Font.Italic = True
    r = r + 1

    ' Total row -- visible sanity check that the bands sum to the denominator.
    Dim bandSum As Long
    bandSum = greenCt + pinkCt + ltGreenCt + orangeCt + draftCt + voidedCt + missedCount
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Total"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = bandSum
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, bandSum, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    If bandSum <> denom Then
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = "MISMATCH: bands sum to " & bandSum & " but denominator is " & _
            denom & " -- report this, there is a bug in the counting logic."
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Bold = True
    End If
    r = r + 2

' ---- Write File A rows to a sheet, filtered by pre-computed section code -

' secArr(i) holds the section code (SEC_EM / SEC_EL / 0) for fullData row i,
' computed once in BuildOutputWorkbook's main pass.
Private Function WriteFilteredFileASheet(ws As Worksheet, fullData As Variant, _
        totalRows As Long, outCols As Long, secArr() As Long, targetSec As Long) As Long

    Dim matchCount As Long, i As Long, j As Long
    For i = 2 To totalRows
        If secArr(i) = targetSec Then matchCount = matchCount + 1
    Next i

    For j = 1 To outCols
        ws.Cells(1, j).Value = fullData(1, j)
    Next j

    If matchCount = 0 Then
        FormatHeaderRow ws, outCols
        ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
        WriteFilteredFileASheet = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim outArr() As Variant
    ReDim outArr(1 To matchCount, 1 To outCols)
    Dim outRow As Long
    For i = 2 To totalRows
        If secArr(i) = targetSec Then
            outRow = outRow + 1
            For j = 1 To outCols
                outArr(outRow, j) = fullData(i, j)
            Next j
        End If
    Next i

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + matchCount, outCols)).Value = outArr
    FormatHeaderRow ws, outCols
    ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
    WriteFilteredFileASheet = matchCount
End Function

' ---- Highlight rows where Latest CCF Creation User was blank (Q7) --------

Private Sub HighlightCCFFallbackRows(ws As Worksheet)
    Dim latestCol As Long, closerCol As Long, encCol As Long
    latestCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
    closerCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "CCF Closed By")
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    If latestCol = 0 Or closerCol = 0 Or encCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub

    Dim rng As Range
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If CellStr(ws.Cells(i, latestCol).Value) = "" And _
           CellStr(ws.Cells(i, closerCol).Value) <> "" Then
            If rng Is Nothing Then
                Set rng = ws.Cells(i, closerCol)
            Else
                Set rng = Union(rng, ws.Cells(i, closerCol))
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    If Not rng Is Nothing Then rng.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 153)
End Sub

' ---- Write Missed FC sheet (File B data as-is) ---------------------------

Private Sub WriteMissedFCSheet(ws As Worksheet, fileBws As Worksheet)
    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileBws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "No encounter column found in File B."
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    lastRow = fileBws.Cells(fileBws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    lastCol = fileBws.Cells(1, fileBws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
    If lastRow < 1 Or lastCol < 1 Then Exit Sub

    Dim data As Variant
    data = fileBws.Range(fileBws.Cells(1, 1), fileBws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value = data
    FormatHeaderRow ws, lastCol
    ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
End Sub

' BuildOutput.bas
'
' Builds the FC Completion Report output workbook:
'   - EM sheet (Emergency encounters from File A)
'   - EL sheet (Elective Inpatient encounters from File A -- every Elective
'     Inpatient encounter, no Point of Care gate -- see "Revert A" below)
'   - Missed FC sheet (File B data) -- SKIPPED when File B was not provided
'   - Summary sheet (reconciliation waterfall + six-band colour-coded
'     completion + team breakdown + NCID ward sub-block)
'   - Methodology sheet (plain-language rule explanation)
'   - Staff Roster Check sheet (roster coverage check, both directions)
'
' 2026-07-30 consolidated change set (validated against
' FCSummaryReport_20260730084420.xlsx, June 2026, against the team's manual
' report for the same month):
'
'   PART 1 -- data-value fixes: ADM_ELECTIVE now matches on a normalised
'     "ELECTIVE INPA" prefix (the export writes "Elective inpa", not
'     "Elective Inpatient"); date parsing fixed from D/M/Y to M/D/Y
'     (TryParseMDYDate, was TryParseDMYDate).
'
'   PART 2 -- REVERT A: the NCID Point of Care list is no longer a gate on
'     the EL sheet/stats -- EL is every Elective Inpatient encounter,
'     Admission Type alone (Q1's original answer was correct). REVERT B:
'     Voided/Deleted-only encounters (priority 99) are back IN the
'     denominator and IN "not completed" -- they get their own Summary row,
'     uncoloured, under the "Not completed (total)" subtotal. Priority 98/99
'     stay separately counted and reported (this split is unchanged). The FC
'     Mode filter still drops Shopper-only encounters entirely, but the count
'     of encounters lost that way is now surfaced on Summary/Methodology.
'
'   PART 3 -- output additions: NCID Point of Care becomes an informational
'     breakdown (not a gate) -- an "NCID Ward" Yes/No column on the EL sheet,
'     an "of which NCID wards" summary sub-block, and a warning for any
'     Point of Care value containing "NCID" that isn't in the configured
'     list. A small-denominator guard suppresses percentages under n=30. A
'     reconciliation waterfall on the Summary sheet lets the team verify the
'     macro's math against a manual run, with a visible balance-check row.
'
'   PART 4 -- staff roster: a roster coverage guard (MainMacro, before this
'     module runs) measures what fraction of encounters map to a named team;
'     BuildOutputWorkbook receives the result (rosterCoverage,
'     unmatchedNames, suppressTeamBlocks) purely for reporting/suppression.
' ============================================================

Public Const SHEET_EM As String = "EM"
Public Const SHEET_EL As String = "EL"

Public Const SHEET_METHODOLOGY As String = "Methodology"

Private Const ADM_EMERGENCY As String = "Emergency"
' The real export writes "Elective inpa" (truncated), not "Elective
' Inpatient" -- matched as a normalised UPPERCASE prefix (PART 1.1,
' 2026-07-30) via IsElectiveAdmType so the full word still matches if eFC
' ever writes it out in full.
Private Const ADM_ELECTIVE As String = "Elective inpa"

'   1 = EM (Emergency)
'   2 = EL (Elective Inpatient -- Admission Type alone, PART 2 Revert A)

Private Const SEC_EM As Long = 1
Private Const SEC_EL As Long = 2

' ---- Highlight rows whose encounter had duplicate FC IDs resolved --------

' Red-fills the Encounter Number cell for every row whose "Duplicate(s)
' Resolved" column (written in BuildOutputWorkbook's main pass) is "Yes" --
' i.e. this is the surviving row of a group that had more than one FC ID
' before automatic resolution. This is CLAUDE.md Step 4 / process flow doc
' item 5's "visual aid" (originally applied to fileAws by
' DeduplicateEncounters.MarkDuplicateEncounters), re-applied here because
' fileAws never reaches the user (closed without saving) and this sheet is
' populated from a plain .Value array that carries no formatting from fileAws.
Private Sub HighlightResolvedDuplicateRows(ws As Worksheet)
    Dim encCol As Long, dupCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    dupCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Duplicate(s) Resolved")
    If encCol = 0 Or dupCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub

    Dim rng As Range
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If CellStr(ws.Cells(i, dupCol).Value) = "Yes" Then
            If rng Is Nothing Then
                Set rng = ws.Cells(i, encCol)
            Else
                Set rng = Union(rng, ws.Cells(i, encCol))
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    If Not rng Is Nothing Then
        rng.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        rng.Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End If
End Sub

'         priority <= 2 (i.e. Completed / Acknowledgement by other means).
'      When both hold, Inflight-created rows are set aside and the winner is
'      recomputed from the remaining (non-Inflight) candidates. Otherwise the
'      plain winner from step 1 stands -- this replaces the old, broader rule
'      that set Inflight rows aside whenever ANY non-Inflight row survived.
'   3. The winner is kept; every other row for that encounter is deleted.
'
' For each Encounter Number with exactly one row, that row is always kept --
' even if its priority is 99 (Voided/Deleted) -- but it is counted in
' voidedOnlyCount so MainMacro/BuildOutput can report it separately. As of
' the 2026-07-30 "Revert B" change, these encounters are NOT excluded from
' the denominator (that was Q4's original answer, but it disagreed with
' actual practice) -- BuildOutput.bas now counts every Voided/Deleted-only
' encounter (whether from a solo group here, or the winner of a group where
' every candidate was Voided/Deleted) IN the denominator and IN "not
' completed", via its own per-row priority-99 check post-dedup.
'
' roster: Dictionary from Helpers.LoadStaffRoster (Staff Name -> Team).
'
' Returns False (and shows a MsgBox) if a required column is missing.
' On success, voidedOnlyCount, duplicateGroupsResolved, rowsRemoved,
' inflightExceptionApplied and inflightExceptionBlocked are filled in for the
' final summary dialog and the Methodology sheet.
Public Function ResolveDuplicateEncounters(ws As Worksheet, roster As Object, _
        ByRef voidedOnlyCount As Long, ByRef duplicateGroupsResolved As Long, _
        ByRef rowsRemoved As Long, ByRef inflightExceptionApplied As Long, _
        ByRef inflightExceptionBlocked As Long) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    voidedOnlyCount = 0
    duplicateGroupsResolved = 0
    rowsRemoved = 0
    inflightExceptionApplied = 0
    inflightExceptionBlocked = 0

    Dim encCol As Long, fcIdCol As Long, fcStatusCol As Long, createdByCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    fcIdCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC ID")
    fcStatusCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Status")
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Created By")

    If encCol = 0 Or fcIdCol = 0 Or fcStatusCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File A is missing one of 'Encounter Number', 'FC ID', or 'FC Status'." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the FC Summary Report export.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        ResolveDuplicateEncounters = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    ResolveDuplicateEncounters = True

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Function
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

    Dim allData As Variant
    allData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

Public Function BuildOutputWorkbook(fileAws As Worksheet, fileBws As Worksheet, _
        roster As Object, ncidPocList As Object, missedFCManualCount As Long, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long, _
        waterfall As Object, _
        rosterCoverage As Double, unmatchedNames As Object, suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    BuildOutputWorkbook = True

    Dim hasFileB As Boolean
    hasFileB = Not (fileBws Is Nothing)

    ' ---- Validate required File A columns ----
    Dim encCol As Long, admTypeCol As Long, fcStatusCol As Long
    Dim createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long, priCol As Long, pocCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    admTypeCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Admission Type")
    fcStatusCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Status")
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Created By")
    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
    priCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "PRIORITISE")
    pocCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Point of Care")

    If encCol = 0 Or admTypeCol = 0 Or fcStatusCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File A is missing a required column (Encounter Number, " & _
               "Admission Type, or FC Status).", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        BuildOutputWorkbook = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' ---- Read File A data ----
    Dim aLastRow As Long, aLastCol As Long
    aLastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    aLastCol = fileAws.Cells(1, fileAws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Dim aData As Variant
    aData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(1, 1), fileAws.Cells(aLastRow, aLastCol)).Value

    ' ---- Build expanded array with extra columns ----
    Dim outCols As Long
    outCols = aLastCol + 4
    Dim ccfCloserCol As Long, ccfTeamCol As Long, looksWrongCol As Long, ncidWardCol As Long
    ccfCloserCol = aLastCol + 1
    ccfTeamCol = aLastCol + 2
    looksWrongCol = aLastCol + 3
    ncidWardCol = aLastCol + 4

    Dim fullData() As Variant
    ReDim fullData(1 To aLastRow, 1 To outCols)

    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    For i = 1 To aLastRow
        For j = 1 To aLastCol
            fullData(i, j) = aData(i, j)
        Next j
    Next i

    fullData(1, ccfCloserCol) = "CCF Closed By"
    fullData(1, ccfTeamCol) = "CCF Closer Team"
    fullData(1, looksWrongCol) = "Looks Wrong"
    fullData(1, ncidWardCol) = "NCID Ward"

    ' secArr(i) = section for fullData row i: SEC_EM, SEC_EL, or 0 (neither).
    Dim secArr() As Long
    ReDim secArr(1 To aLastRow)

' ---- Highlight rows whose encounter had duplicate FC IDs resolved --------

' Red-fills the Encounter Number cell for every row whose "Duplicate(s)
' Resolved" column (written in BuildOutputWorkbook's main pass) is "Yes" --
' i.e. this is the surviving row of a group that had more than one FC ID
' before automatic resolution. This is CLAUDE.md Step 4 / process flow doc
' item 5's "visual aid" (originally applied to fileAws by
' DeduplicateEncounters.MarkDuplicateEncounters), re-applied here because
' fileAws never reaches the user (closed without saving) and this sheet is
' populated from a plain .Value array that carries no formatting from fileAws.
Private Sub HighlightResolvedDuplicateRows(ws As Worksheet)
    Dim encCol As Long, dupCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    dupCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Duplicate(s) Resolved")
    If encCol = 0 Or dupCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub

    Dim rng As Range
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If CellStr(ws.Cells(i, dupCol).Value) = "Yes" Then
            If rng Is Nothing Then
                Set rng = ws.Cells(i, encCol)
            Else
                Set rng = Union(rng, ws.Cells(i, encCol))
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    If Not rng Is Nothing Then
        rng.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        rng.Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End If
End Sub

## 2026-07-30 bug fix: duplicate-highlight visual aid never reached the user

Code review found that `DeduplicateEncounters.MarkDuplicateEncounters` (CLAUDE.md
Step 4 / process flow doc item 5 -- "highlight duplicate encounter numbers in
red... a visual aid so staff can see at a glance which encounters had more
than one FC ID") had no effect the user could ever see:

- It colours cells on `wsA` (the File A workbook opened via the file picker),
  but `MainMacro.GenerateFCCompletionReport` closes that workbook with
  `SaveChanges:=False` at the end of the run.
- `BuildOutputWorkbook` builds the EM/EL sheets by reading `fileAws` into a
  plain `Variant` array (`.Value`) and writing that array into new sheets --
  this copies values only, never cell formatting, so even if `wsA` had been
  left open, the red fill would not have propagated to the deliverable.

Net effect: the highlighting was computed and then thrown away every run --
staff had no way to see, in the actual output workbook, which surviving rows
had duplicate FC IDs resolved out from under them.

**Fix** -- moved the visual aid to the sheets staff actually receive:
- `DeduplicateEncounters.ResolveDuplicateEncounters` gained a new `ByRef
  resolvedEncounters As Object` out-parameter: a Dictionary keyed by Encounter
  Number for every encounter that had more than one row before resolution
  (populated at the same point `duplicateGroupsResolved` is incremented).
- `MainMacro.GenerateFCCompletionReport` threads this dictionary from
  `ResolveDuplicateEncounters` straight through to `BuildOutputWorkbook`.
- `BuildOutput.BuildOutputWorkbook` gained a matching `resolvedEncounters As
  Object` parameter, a new "Duplicate(s) Resolved" column (Yes/blank, same
  pattern as "CCF Closed By"/"Looks Wrong"/"NCID Ward"), and a new
  `HighlightResolvedDuplicateRows` sub (modelled on the existing
  `HighlightCCFFallbackRows`) that red-fills the Encounter Number cell on the
  EM/EL sheets for every row flagged "Yes" -- called right after
  `WriteFilteredFileASheet` for both `wsEM` and `wsEL`.

Applied to both `DeduplicateEncounters.bas`/`MainMacro.bas`/`BuildOutput.bas`
and their mirror in `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` (verified byte-identical
after the edit). **Needs user re-compile** (Alt+F11 -> Debug -> Compile
VBAProject) -- not yet tested against a real export.

content.text:
I've completed a manual code review of this repo (the earlier subagent failed on a spend limit) and fixed the one real, verified bug I found.

**Finding:** CLAUDE.md's Step 4 / the process flow doc's item 5 requires highlighting duplicate Encounter Numbers in red as a "visual aid so staff can see at a glance which encounters had more than one FC ID." `MarkDuplicateEncounters` implemented this correctly — but on `wsA`, the input File A workbook, which `MainMacro` closes with `SaveChanges:=False` at the end of every run. Worse, `BuildOutputWorkbook` populates the EM/EL output sheets by reading `fileAws` into a plain `.Value` array and writing that array to new sheets — which copies values only, never cell formatting. So the highlighting was computed every run and then thrown away twice over; staff never saw it in the actual deliverable.

**Fix applied** (to `.bas` files, their `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` mirror — verified byte-identical — and `docs/VBA_Code_Progress.md`):
- `DeduplicateEncounters.ResolveDuplicateEncounters` now returns a `resolvedEncounters` dictionary of every encounter number that had duplicates resolved.
- `MainMacro` threads that dictionary through to `BuildOutputWorkbook`.
- `BuildOutput.BuildOutputWorkbook` writes a new "Duplicate(s) Resolved" column and a new `HighlightResolvedDuplicateRows` sub red-fills the Encounter Number cell on the EM/EL sheets for those rows — so the visual aid now actually lands in the workbook staff receive.

Everything else I checked (priority scoring, dedup tie-breaks, the narrowed Inflight exception's AND logic, EM/EL split by Admission Type alone, denominator/Voided-Deleted inclusion, `FindColByHeader`/`IIf` discipline, dash normalization) matched the spec correctly. This needs a re-compile (Alt+F11 → Debug → Compile VBAProject) and a test run against a real export before you rely on it.
